**Justification:** iDISCO+ is ideal for whole-body mouse clearing due to its excellent lipid removal efficiency, compatibility with endogenous fluorescent proteins (like mCherry/RFP), and ability to preserve fine cellular morphology. It is fast compared to aqueous-based methods and allows for subsequent immunolabeling. The use of mCherry/RFP-expressing tumor cells enables direct visualization of metastatic cells. CD31 labeling highlights vasculature to provide anatomical context and aid in organ segmentation. DAPI is used to label nuclei for cellular resolution and background discrimination. This combination ensures high-resolution 3D mapping of single or small clusters of tumor cells across the whole mouse body.

---

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Tissue Optical Clearing  
1.1 Incubation with methanol (MeOH) at gradually increasing concentrations: 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100% (each for 24 hours). (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 5 days total)  
1.2 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H₂O₂ in methanol for bleaching. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
1.3 Incubation with methanol for 24 hours to remove residual H₂O₂. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)

2 Immunolabeling  
2.1 Incubation with blocking/permeabilization solution (0.2% gelatin, 0.5% Triton X-100, 15% DMSO in PBS) for 48 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 48 hours)  
2.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: rat anti-CD31 (1:500 dilution), in blocking solution for 7 days. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 7 days)  
2.3 Wash with PBS containing 0.1% Tween-20 (PBST) for 6 × 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 6 days total)  
2.4 Incubation with secondary antibody: Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-rat IgG (1:1000 dilution) and DAPI (1:10,000 dilution) in blocking solution for 7 days. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 7 days)  
2.5 Wash with PBST for 6 × 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 6 days total)

3 Delipidation and Clearing  
3.1 Incubation with dichloromethane (DCM) for 6 hours to dehydrate and initiate delipidation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  
3.2 Incubation with DCM for an additional 18 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 18 hours)  
3.3 Incubation with DCM containing 0.001% BHT to prevent autofluorescence. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
3.4 Incubation with 1:1 DCM:BABB (benzyl alcohol/benzyl benzoate) for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
3.5 Incubation with 100% BABB containing 0.001% BHT for final clearing. (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)

4 Refractive Index (RI) Matching  
4.1 Incubation with RI-matching solution (100% BABB + 0.001% BHT) for 24 hours prior to imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

5 Imaging and Storage  
5.1 Mount sample in BABB in a custom imaging chamber with spacers to avoid compression.  
5.2 Store sample in BABB at RT in the dark for long-term preservation.  
5.3 Image using light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM) or high-penetration confocal microscopy with appropriate filter sets:  
 - mCherry/RFP: excitation ~587 nm, emission ~610 nm  
 - Alexa Fluor 488: excitation ~488 nm, emission ~525 nm  
 - DAPI: excitation ~358 nm, emission ~461 nm  

6 Optional: 3D Reconstruction and Analysis  
6.1 Use Imaris, Fiji, or similar software to reconstruct 3D volumes.  
6.2 Segment organs based on CD31 signal and anatomical landmarks.  
6.3 Detect and quantify mCherry+ tumor cells relative to DAPI nuclear staining and exclude autofluorescent particles using spectral unmixing and thresholding.

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [mCherry/RFP, E-cadherin+Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is highly suitable for whole-body mouse optical clearing due to its excellent lipid removal efficiency, compatibility with endogenous fluorescent proteins (e.g., mCherry/RFP), and ability to penetrate deeply into large tissues. It is also compatible with immunolabeling, allowing for dual-channel validation using antibodies such as anti-E-cadherin conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647, which is critical for confirming epithelial tumor cell identity. The methanol-based dehydration and BABB clearing steps preserve fluorescence well and allow for high-resolution 3D imaging. This method supports single-cell level detection and quantitative analysis across organs, aligning with the scientific goal of identifying and characterizing micro-metastases in a breast cancer model.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Tissue Optical Clearing  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH). (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
1.7 Incubation with 100% methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Immunolabeling  
2.1 Incubation with blocking solution (10% DMSO, 5% donkey serum in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
2.2 Incubation with primary antibody: anti-E-cadherin (1:500 dilution) in labeling solution (1% DMSO, 3% donkey serum in PBS) for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
2.3 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% Tween-20 (PBST), 6 times for 1 hour each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total)  
2.4 Incubation with secondary antibody: Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:1000 dilution) in labeling solution for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
2.5 Wash with PBST, 6 times for 1 hour each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total)  

3 Delipidation and Clearing  
3.1 Incubation with 1:2 mixture of dichloromethane (DCM) and methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 100% DCM for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with BABB clearing solution (1 part benzyl benzoate, 2 parts benzyl alcohol) for 12 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  

4 Refractive Index (RI) Matching  
4.1 Incubation with RI-matching solution (BABB containing 0.001% Sudan Black B to reduce background autofluorescence) for 12 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  

5 Sample Preservation and Imaging Preparation  
5.1 Mount sample in custom chamber filled with BABB solution.  
5.2 Store at 4 °C in the dark until imaging.  
5.3 Image using light-sheet or two-photon microscopy with appropriate filter sets for mCherry (Ex: 560 nm/Em: 600 nm) and Alexa Fluor 647 (Ex: 640 nm/Em: 665 nm).

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Tissue Preprocessing  
1.1 Incubate fixed adult mouse in 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS for 24 hours to enhance permeabilization. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
1.2 Wash sample in PBS for 6 hours with 3 changes of solution to remove residual fixative. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 6 hours total)  

2 Immunolabeling  
2.1 Incubate sample in blocking solution (10% DMSO, 5% donkey serum, 0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
2.2 Incubate with primary antibody: rat anti-mouse E-cadherin (1:200 dilution) in labeling buffer (1% DMSO, 1% donkey serum, 0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS) for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
2.3 Wash in PBS with 0.2% Triton X-100 for 6 hours with 3 changes. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 6 hours total)  
2.4 Incubate with secondary antibody: Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated donkey anti-rat IgG (1:500) in labeling buffer for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
2.5 Wash in PBS with 0.2% Triton X-100 for 6 hours with 3 changes. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 6 hours total)  

3 Dehydration  
3.1 Incubate in 20% methanol in PBS for 6 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  
3.2 Incubate in 40% methanol in PBS for 6 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  
3.3 Incubate in 60% methanol in PBS for 6 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  
3.4 Incubate in 80% methanol in PBS for 6 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  
3.5 Incubate in 100% methanol for 12 hours with two changes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours total)  

4 Delipidation  
4.1 Incubate in freshly prepared dichloromethane (DCM)/methanol (2:1 vol/vol) for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Replace with fresh DCM/methanol (2:1) and incubate for another 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Bleaching (Optional for Autofluorescence Reduction)  
5.1 Incubate in 5% H2O2 in methanol for 12–24 hours until desired bleaching is achieved. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
5.2 Wash in 100% methanol for 6 hours with 2 changes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total)

6.2 Incubate in 60% methanol in PBS for 6 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

**Protocol Steps:**

1.1 Incubation with chilled 100% methanol for 24 hours to dehydrate and begin bleaching. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)

1.3 Wash with 80% methanol in PBS for 2 hours to remove residual H2O2. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 2 hours)  
1.4 Wash with 50% methanol in PBS for 2 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 2 hours)  
1.5 Wash with PBS for 2 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 2 hours)  

2 Immunolabeling  
2.1 Incubation with blocking solution (10% DMSO, 5% donkey serum in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)

2.3 Wash with PBS containing 0.1% Tween-20 (PBST) for 6 × 2 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, each wash: 2 hours)

请根据该科学问题自行选择合适的荧光/标记策略，并基于所选标记样本选择匹配的组织透明方法。若限制范围内的凝集素或血管腔面探针能够直接完成血管网络标记，则不应额外选择抗体靶点；若需要确认血管内皮身份或结构完整性，则再选择给定标记物列表中的兼容靶点。请仅输出 protocol，第 1 行写明所选荧光/标记策略和组织透明方法，随后仅列出透明处理、RI 匹配和保存/成像前处理步骤的关键试剂、条件和时间。

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [IB4-Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is ideal for whole-organ clearing of fixed tissues, especially for imaging deep vascular structures in large samples (up to 1 cm diameter). It provides excellent optical clearing, good preservation of fluorescent signals, and compatibility with endogenous and lectin-based labeling. IB4 (isolectin B4) specifically binds to endothelial cells in mouse vasculature and, when conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647, provides high-contrast labeling of the microvasculature without the need for secondary antibodies. DAPI is used for nuclear counterstaining to identify tumor cell distribution. iDISCO+ uses methanol-based dehydration and BABB-based refractive index matching, which is effective for clearing melanin-rich tissues where light scattering is a major issue.

---

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Tissue Permeabilization and Blocking  
1.1 Incubation with freshly prepared 20 mg/mL glycine in PBS for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with permeabilization solution (0.3% Triton X-100, 0.1% sodium azide in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
1.3 Incubation with blocking solution (0.3% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, 5% donkey serum in PBS) for 48 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 48 hours)  

2 Vascular Labeling with IB4-Alexa Fluor 647  
2.1 Incubation with IB4-Alexa Fluor 647 (1:200 dilution in blocking solution) for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
2.2 Wash with 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS (5× 24 hours). (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 5 × 24 hours)  

3 Nuclear Staining with DAPI  
3.1 Incubation with DAPI (1 μg/mL in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
3.2 Wash with PBS (3× 6 hours). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 6 hours)  

4 Dehydration  
4.1 Incubation with 50% methanol in PBS for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with 80% methanol in PBS for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
4.3 Incubation with 100% methanol for 2 hours (2 changes). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours per change)  

5 Bleaching (to reduce melanin autofluorescence and absorption)  
5.1 Incubation with chilled 5% H₂O₂ in methanol for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
5.2 Wash with 100% methanol until bubbles stop (2–3 changes, ~6 hours each). (Temperature: RT, Time: ~6 hours per change)  

6 Delipidation and Clearing  
6.1 Incubation with freshly prepared iDISCO+ clearing solution (1:2 benzyl alcohol:benzyl benzoate, BABB) for 48 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)  
6.2 Replace with fresh BABB and incubate for another 48 hours or until tissue becomes fully transparent. (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)  

7 Refractive Index (RI) Matching  
7.1 Incubation with RI matching solution (100% dibenzyl ether, DBE) for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
7.2 Replace with fresh DBE and incubate for an additional 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

8 Imaging Preparation  
8.1 Mount tumor in a glass-bottom imaging dish using DBE.  
8.2 Image using light-sheet or two-photon microscopy for 3D visualization of microvasculature and tumor architecture.  

9 Optional Long-Term Storage  
9.1 Store cleared sample in DBE at 4 °C in the dark. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: up to several months)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [CD31 (PECAM1), Lectin (IB4)-Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** uDISCO is ideal for large, pigmented tissues like melanoma due to its strong delipidation and depigmentation steps, which significantly improve light penetration and reduce autofluorescence. It also preserves fluorescent proteins and antibody labeling well, which is critical for distinguishing structural (CD31+) and functional (Lectin-labeled) vasculature. Lectin (IB4) conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 is a widely used vascular perfusion marker that labels the luminal surface of perfused vessels, making it ideal for identifying functional vasculature. CD31 (PECAM1) labels all endothelial cells, allowing visualization of the full vascular network. This combination enables spatial comparison of structural and functional vessel distribution in tumor core, margin, and periphery.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Immunolabeling (if not already performed)  
1.1 Incubation with blocking solution (10% normal goat serum, 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: rat anti-CD31 (1:200 dilution) in labeling buffer (1% NGS, 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS) for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.3 Wash with PBS containing 0.1% Tween-20 (PBST), 6 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total)  
1.4 Incubation with secondary antibody: Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-rat IgG (1:500 dilution) and IB4-Alexa Fluor 647 (1:200 dilution) in labeling buffer for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.5 Wash with PBST, 6 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total)  

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% methanol in PBS for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% methanol in PBS for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% methanol in PBS for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% methanol in PBS for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% methanol, 2 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours total)  

3 Delipidation/Depigmentation  
3.1 Incubation with freshly prepared dichloromethane:methanol (2:1 vol/vol) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Repeat step 3.1 for 2–3 cycles until tissue becomes visibly transparent. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3–5 hours total)  
3.3 Wash with 100% methanol, 2 × 30 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour total)  

4 Bleaching (if residual pigmentation remains)  
4.1 Incubation with 5% H₂O₂ in methanol at 4 °C for 12–24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12–24 hours)  
4.2 Wash with 100% methanol, 3 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours total)  

5 Rehydration  
5.1 Incubation with 80% methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.2 Incubation with 60% methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.3 Incubation with 40% methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.4 Incubation with 20% methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.5 Incubation with PBS for 2 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours total)  

6 Tissue Clearing  
6.1 Incubation with uDISCO-I (dichloromethane: methanol = 1:2, v/v) for 1–2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
6.2 Incubation with uDISCO-II (100% dichloromethane) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.3 Incubation with uDISCO-III (DCM: BABB = 1:1, v/v) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.4 Incubation with uDISCO-IV (100% BABB) until fully transparent (typically 2–4 hours). (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)  

7 Refractive Index (RI) Matching  
7.1 Incubation with dibenzyl ether (DBE) for RI matching. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12–24 hours)  

8 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
8.1 Store sample in DBE at 4 °C until imaging. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: up to several weeks)  
8.2 Mount sample in DBE-filled chamber with low-autofluorescence coverslip for light-sheet or confocal imaging.

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [IB4-Alexa Fluor 647, Lectin-Alexa Fluor 594, Collagen IV, DAPI]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is ideal for large, pigmented tissues like melanoma due to its superior optical clearing and pigment removal capabilities. It enables high-resolution 3D imaging of deep structures using light-sheet or confocal microscopy. The selected labeling strategy combines functional (IB4 and Lectin) and structural (Collagen IV) vascular markers with nuclear counterstaining (DAPI), allowing for comprehensive analysis of vascular architecture, perfusion, and microenvironmental interactions. The use of far-red fluorophores minimizes melanin-induced signal attenuation.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Tissue Washing and Permeabilization  
1.1 Incubation with PBS containing 0.5% Triton X-100 for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
1.2 Wash with PBS (3× 1 hour each) to remove detergent. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours total)

2 Whole-mount Immunolabeling  
2.1 Incubation with blocking solution: 10% normal goat serum, 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
2.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: Collagen IV (1:200 dilution) in blocking solution for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
2.3 Wash with PBS + 0.1% Triton X-100 (5× 2 hours each). (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 hours total)  
2.4 Incubation with secondary antibody: Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:500) and IB4-Alexa Fluor 647 (1:200), Lectin-Alexa Fluor 594 (1:200), and DAPI (1:1000) in blocking solution for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
2.5 Wash with PBS + 0.1% Triton X-100 (5× 2 hours each). (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 hours total)

3 Dehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 20% methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 40% methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 60% methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 80% methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with 100% methanol (2× 1 hour each). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours total)

4 Delipidation and Clearing  
4.1 Incubation with freshly prepared dichloromethane (DCM) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.2 Incubation with DCM containing 3% H2O2 for 1 hour to remove melanin and autofluorescence. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.3 Wash with 100% methanol (2× 30 minutes each). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour total)  
4.4 Incubation with BABB clearing solution (1:2 benzyl alcohol:benzyl benzoate) for 12 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

5 Refractive Index (RI) Matching  
5.1 Incubation with RI-matching solution (1.56 RI, e.g., dibutyl phthalate or custom RI gel) for 12 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

6 Mounting and Imaging  
6.1 Mount sample in RI-matched chamber with support gel (if needed).  
6.2 Image using light-sheet or confocal microscopy with multi-channel detection for Alexa Fluor 488 (Collagen IV), Alexa Fluor 594 (Lectin), Alexa Fluor 647 (IB4), and DAPI.  
6.3 Acquire z-stacks with appropriate step size (e.g., 2–5 µm) for 3D reconstruction and vascular morphometric analysis.

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [CD31 (PECAM1), IB4 (凝集素), Lectin (凝集素)]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is highly effective for pigmented tissues like melanoma due to its methanol-based dehydration and delipidation steps, which efficiently remove melanin and reduce background absorption. It preserves endogenous fluorescence and is compatible with immunolabeling. CD31 labels endothelial cells for structural vascular network visualization, while IB4 and Lectin label luminal surfaces of perfused vessels, enabling functional assessment. These markers are compatible with red and far-red channels, ideal for deep imaging after clearing.

---

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Immunolabeling (if not already performed)  
1.1 Incubation with blocking solution (10% normal goat serum, 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: rat anti-CD31 (1:200), Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated IB4 (1:100), and Alexa Fluor 594-conjugated Lectin (1:100) in labeling buffer (1% DMSO, 0.3% Triton X-100, 0.01% sodium azide in PBS) for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.3 Wash with 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS (6 × 1 hour). (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 × 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with secondary antibody (if needed; e.g., goat anti-rat Alexa Fluor 568, 1:500) in labeling buffer for 48 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 48 hours)  
1.5 Wash with 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS (6 × 1 hour). (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 × 1 hour)

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.6 Incubation with chilled 100% methanol for 2 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 2 hours)

3 Bleaching (Melanin removal)  
3.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH). (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
3.2 Wash with 100% methanol (3 × 1 hour). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 1 hour)

4 Delipidation  
4.1 Incubation with freshly prepared dichloromethane (DCM) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.2 Incubation with DCM for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.3 Incubation with DCM for 12–24 hours (until tissue becomes translucent). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12–24 hours)

5 Rehydration  
5.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.5 Incubation with PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

6 Refractive Index (RI) Matching  
6.1 Incubation with iDISCO+ RI matching solution (DBE/Toluene, 1:1 vol/vol) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.2 Incubation with 100% dibenzyl ether (DBE) for 1–3 hours (until tissue sinks and becomes fully transparent). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1–3 hours)

7 Mounting and Imaging  
7.1 Mount sample in a glass-bottom dish or imaging chamber using DBE.  
7.2 Image using light-sheet or confocal microscopy with red (561 nm) and far-red (640 nm) excitation for CD31 and IB4/Lectin, respectively.  
7.3 Perform 3D reconstruction of vascular networks using Imaris, Fiji, or similar software.

The use of Pan-Cytokeratin-Alexa Fluor 647 specifically labels epithelial cancer cells, DAPI provides nuclear counterstain for spatial orientation, and CD31 highlights vasculature to aid in anatomical context and registration. These fluorophores are compatible with iDISCO+ protocols and are preserved well under its methanol-based dehydration and delipidation steps.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Immunolabeling (if not already performed)  
1.1 Incubate tissue in blocking/permeabilization solution: 0.3% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 5% (wt/vol) BSA in PBS. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
1.2 Incubate with primary antibodies: Pan-Cytokeratin (1:200), CD31 (1:100) in blocking solution. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
1.3 Wash 3× with 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS, 1 hour each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours total)  
1.4 Incubate with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-mouse/rabbit IgG (1:500), Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-rat IgG (1:500), and DAPI (1:1000) in blocking solution. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
1.5 Wash 3× with 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS, 1 hour each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours total)  

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubate in 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for equilibration. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Transfer to 40% methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Proceed to 60% methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubate in 80% methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Transfer to 100% methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

3 Delipidation  
3.1 Incubate in freshly prepared 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) and 33% methanol solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Replace with fresh 100% DCM. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
3.3 Repeat 100% DCM incubation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

4 Rehydration  
4.1 Incubate in 80% DCM / 20% methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.2 Transfer to 50% DCM / 50% methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.3 Incubate in 20% DCM / 80% methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.4 Transfer to 100% methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.5 Incubate in 80% methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.6 Transfer to 60% methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.7 Incubate in 40% methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.8 Transfer to 20% methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.9 Incubate in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

5.1 Incubate in iDISCO+ RI matching solution: 62.5% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE) and 37.5% (vol/vol) benzyl alcohol (BA). (Temperature: RT, Time: 6–12 hours)

6.1 Mount sample in a glass-bottom dish or imaging chamber using 100% DBE.  
6.2 Image using light-sheet or confocal microscopy with appropriate filter sets for DAPI (blue), Alexa Fluor 488 (green), and Alexa Fluor 647 (far-red).

请根据该科学问题自行选择合适的荧光/标记策略，并匹配适合快速活检组织三维成像的组织透明方法。若限制范围内的直接染料只能提供核定位或组织形态参考，可作为辅助信号；癌细胞身份确认应依赖给定标记物列表中的上皮性肿瘤相关标记。请仅输出 protocol，第 1 行写明所选荧光/标记策略和组织透明方法，随后仅列出透明处理、RI 匹配和保存/成像前处理步骤的关键试剂、条件和时间。

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Pan-Cytokeratin+Alexa Fluor 594, DAPI, CD31+Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is ideal for rapid optical clearing of fixed biopsy-sized tissues (up to 1 cm³), with excellent preservation of fluorescent signals and compatibility with immunolabeling. It uses a methanol-based delipidation protocol that clears tissues within 24–48 hours, suitable for the time constraint. Pan-Cytokeratin labels epithelial cancer cells specifically, DAPI provides nuclear reference for spatial mapping, and CD31 highlights vasculature to aid in orientation and structural context. This combination enables precise 3D localization of cancer nests, single cancer cells, and micro-residual disease near the resection margin.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Immunolabeling (if not pre-labeled)  
1.1 Incubation with blocking solution (10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 5% (wt/vol) BSA, 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 in PBS) for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: Pan-Cytokeratin (1:200), CD31 (1:100) in labeling buffer (1% BSA, 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
1.3 Wash with PBS containing 0.1% Tween-20 (PBST) for 3 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours total)  
1.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 594-conjugated anti-mouse IgG and Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-rat IgG (both at 1:500) in labeling buffer for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
1.5 Wash with PBST for 3 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours total)  
1.6 Incubation with DAPI (1:10,000 in PBS) for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
1.7 Wash with PBS for 2 × 30 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour total)

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% methanol for 2 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours total)

3 Delipidation  
3.1 Incubation with freshly prepared 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 100% DCM for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 100% DCM for additional 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) DCM in methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4 Rehydration  
4.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.5 Incubation with PBS for 2 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours total)

5 Tissue Clearing  
5.1 Incubation with iDISCO+ clearing solution (20% (wt/vol) DMSO, 30% (vol/vol) H2O, 50% (vol/vol) ethyl cinnamate (ECi)) for 12–24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

6 Refractive Index (RI) Matching  
6.1 Incubation with fresh ECi clearing solution (100%) for 6–12 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

7 Mounting and Imaging Preparation  
7.1 Mount tissue in a glass-bottom dish or imaging chamber using 100% ECi.  
7.2 Seal the chamber and store in the dark at RT until imaging. (Time: up to 1 week)  
7.3 Image using light-sheet or high-penetration confocal microscopy with appropriate filters for DAPI (Ex: 405 nm), Alexa Fluor 594 (Ex: 594 nm), and Alexa Fluor 647 (Ex: 647 nm).

This combination enables precise 3D localization of residual cancer cells near the surgical margin.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Immunolabeling Completion and Washing  
1.1 Incubation with PBS containing 0.3% Triton X-100 and 5% normal goat serum for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.3 Wash with PBS + 0.1% Triton X-100 (3 × 1 hour). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-mouse and Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-rabbit in PBS + 0.3% Triton X-100 + 2% normal goat serum for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
1.5 Wash with PBS + 0.1% Triton X-100 (3 × 1 hour). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with DAPI (1:10,000) in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.7 Wash with PBS (3 × 30 minutes). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 minutes)

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 50% methanol in PBS for 30 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
2.2 Incubation with 70% methanol in PBS for 30 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
2.3 Incubation with 100% methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with fresh 100% methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3 Delipidation and Clearing  
3.1 Incubation with FOCM-L solution (20% w/v methyl salicylate, 80% methanol) for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

CK19 labels luminal epithelial cells (cancer-associated in prostate), p63 labels basal cells (whose loss is a hallmark of malignancy), and DAPI provides nuclear morphology and cell density information. This combination enables precise 3D mapping of glandular architecture, basal cell layer integrity, and cancerous structural features such as cribriform patterns and infiltrative growth. The methanol-based delipidation ensures rapid clearing while maintaining structural integrity and antigenicity.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Immunolabeling (if not already performed)

1.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-CK19 (1:200 dilution) and anti-p63 (1:100 dilution) in labeling buffer (1% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.05% (wt/vol) sodium azide in PBS) for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.3 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (6 × 1 hour). (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 × 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 488 anti-mouse (for CK19) and Alexa Fluor 594 anti-rabbit (for p63), both at 1:500 dilution in labeling buffer for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.5 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (6 × 1 hour). (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 × 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with DAPI (1:10,000 dilution in PBS) for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

3 Delipidation  
3.1 Incubation with freshly prepared 5% (vol/vol) H2O2 in methanol (1 volume of 30% H2O2 in 5 volumes of methanol) at 4 °C for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  

4 Rehydration  
4.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.5 Incubation with PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

5 Tissue Optical Clearing  
5.1 Incubation with iDISCO+ clearing solution (Dibenzyl ether, DBE) without shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  

6 Refractive Index (RI) Matching  
6.1 Incubation with fresh DBE in a sealed vial to prevent evaporation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

7.1 Mount sample in a glass-bottom dish or imaging chamber using 1% (wt/vol) low-melting agarose in PBS to stabilize the needle core.  
7.2 Submerge in DBE for imaging.

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [CK19 (导管), p63, DAPI]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is a fast, effective, and well-established method for optical clearing of fixed tissues, especially for immunolabeled samples. It is particularly suitable for small biopsy cores like prostate needle biopsies due to its compatibility with immunostaining and excellent preservation of fluorescent signals. The methanol-based delipidation is efficient and allows deep penetration of antibodies and dyes. CK19 labels the luminal epithelium of glands, distinguishing cancer-associated epithelium; p63 labels the basal cell layer, which is critical for identifying glandular integrity; and DAPI serves as a nuclear counterstain to aid in morphological orientation and segmentation.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Immunolabeling (if not already performed)  
1.1 Incubation with blocking solution (10% normal goat serum, 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-CK19 (1:200) and anti-p63 (1:100) in labeling buffer (3% normal goat serum, 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS) for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.3 Wash with 0.1% Tween-20 in PBS (PBST), 6 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total)  
1.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 488 anti-mouse (for CK19) and Alexa Fluor 594 anti-rabbit (for p63), both at 1:500 dilution, in labeling buffer for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.5 Wash with PBST, 6 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total)  
1.6 Incubation with DAPI (1:10,000 dilution in PBS) for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% methanol for 1 hour (×2 changes). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours total)  

3 Delipidation  
3.1 Incubation with freshly prepared 66% dichloromethane (DCM), 33% methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 100% DCM for 1 hour (×2 changes). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours total)  

4 Rehydration  
4.1 Incubation with 80% methanol in PBS for 15 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  
4.2 Incubation with 60% methanol in PBS for 15 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  
4.3 Incubation with 40% methanol in PBS for 15 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  
4.4 Incubation with 20% methanol in PBS for 15 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  
4.5 Incubation with PBS for 30 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

5 Refractive Index (RI) Matching  
5.1 Incubation with iDISCO+ RI matching solution (DBE/Toluene, 1:1 vol/vol) for 3 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
5.2 Incubation with 100% dibenzyl ether (DBE) for 12 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  

6 Mounting and Imaging  
6.1 Mount sample in a glass-bottom dish or imaging chamber using 100% DBE.  
6.2 Image using light-sheet or high-resolution confocal microscopy with appropriate filter sets for DAPI, Alexa Fluor 488, and Alexa Fluor 594.  

7 Storage (if needed)  
7.1 Store sample in 100% DBE at 4 °C in the dark. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: up to several weeks)

1.1 Incubation with blocking solution (10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 5% (vol/vol) donkey serum, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)

1.3 Wash with 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS (6 × 2 hours). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours total)  
1.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 488 anti-mouse (1:500), Alexa Fluor 555 anti-rabbit (1:500), Alexa Fluor 647 anti-rat (1:500) in labeling buffer for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.5 Wash with 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS (6 × 2 hours). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours total)  
1.6 Incubation with DAPI (1:10,000 in PBS) for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% methanol for 1 hour (2 changes). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours total)  

3 Delipidation  
3.1 Incubation with freshly prepared dichloromethane (DCM)/methanol (2:1 vol/vol) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 100% DCM for 1 hour (2 changes). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours total)  

4 Rehydration

**Chosen Method:** ScaleS  
**Chosen Labeling:** [DAPI, α-SMA, E-cadherin]  
**Justification:** ScaleS is a sorbitol-based aqueous clearing method that provides excellent tissue shape preservation, minimal shrinkage or expansion, and good fluorescence compatibility. It is ideal for preserving the fine 3D architecture of small, fixed needle-core biopsies like prostate tissue. DAPI labels nuclear morphology for Gleason scoring, α-SMA highlights the basal cell layer, and E-cadherin labels luminal epithelial cells, enabling visualization of glandular architecture, basal layer integrity, and cancer-related structural changes such as gland fusion and loss of polarity. These markers are well-established in prostate pathology and compatible with immunolabeling in ScaleS-cleared tissue.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Immunolabeling (if not already performed)
1.1 Incubation with blocking solution (10% normal goat serum, 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS) for 24 hours (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: mouse anti-α-SMA (1:200), rabbit anti-E-cadherin (1:200) in labeling buffer (1% NGS, 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS) for 72 hours (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.3 Wash with PBS containing 0.1% Triton X-100 (3 × 1 hour) (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 488 goat anti-mouse and Alexa Fluor 555 goat anti-rabbit (1:500 each) with DAPI (1:10,000) in labeling buffer for 72 hours (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.5 Wash with PBS containing 0.1% Triton X-100 (3 × 1 hour) (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 1 hour)

2 ScaleS Clearing
2.1 Incubation with ScaleS1 solution (4 M urea, 10% methanol, 25% w/v sorbitol in PBS) for 24 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
2.2 Incubation with fresh ScaleS1 solution for 24 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
2.3 Incubation with ScaleS2 solution (4 M urea, 10% methanol, 50% w/v sorbitol in PBS) for 24 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
2.4 Incubation with fresh ScaleS2 solution for 24 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

3 Refractive Index (RI) Matching
3.1 Incubation with ScaleS3 solution (4 M urea, 10% methanol, 70% w/v sorbitol in PBS, RI ~1.45) for 24 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
3.2 Incubation with fresh ScaleS3 solution for final RI stabilization for 24–48 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 24–48 hours)

4 Mounting and Imaging
4.1 Mount tissue in custom chamber or capillary tube with ScaleS3 solution to maintain RI matching  
4.2 Image using light-sheet or high-numerical aperture confocal microscope with water or silicone immersion objectives  
4.3 Store cleared and labeled tissue in ScaleS3 at 4 °C for up to several weeks without significant signal loss

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [CD31-Alexa Fluor 647, ER-TR7-Alexa Fluor 488, DAPI]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is ideal for whole-organ immunolabeling and optical clearing of small tissues like lymph nodes. It preserves fluorescence well, especially from Alexa Fluor dyes, and allows deep penetration of antibodies. CD31 labels all endothelial cells including HEVs, ER-TR7 labels HEV-specific basement membrane, and DAPI provides nuclear density as a proxy for lymphocyte-rich zones. This combination enables 3D visualization of HEV networks and their spatial relationship with lymphocyte clusters and stromal structures.

---

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Immunolabeling (if not already performed)  
1.1 Incubation with blocking/permeabilization solution (10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 5% (vol/vol) donkey serum, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-CD31 (PECAM1) and anti-ER-TR7 in labeling buffer (1% DMSO, 1% donkey serum, 0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS) for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.3 Wash with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS (6 × 1 hour). (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 × 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-rat and Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-rabbit for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.5 Wash with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS (6 × 1 hour). (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 × 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with DAPI (1:10,000 dilution in PBS) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.7 Wash with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS (3 × 30 minutes). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 minutes)

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% methanol for 1 hour (2 × 1 hour). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)

3 Delipidation  
3.1 Incubation with freshly prepared 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 100% DCM for 1 hour (2 × 1 hour). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 100% DCM with 5% (vol/vol) H2O2 for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
3.4 Incubation with 100% DCM for 1 hour (2 × 1 hour). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)

4 Rehydration  
4.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) DCM/methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.2 Incubation with 33% (vol/vol) DCM/methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.3 Incubation with 100% methanol for 1 hour (2 × 1 hour). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)  
4.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.5 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.6 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.7 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.8 Incubation with PBS for 1 hour (3 × 1 hour). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 1 hour)

5 Tissue Optical Clearing  
5.1 Incubation with iDISCO+ clearing solution (DBE:Tween 20 = 2:1 vol/vol) for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
5.2 Incubation with fresh iDISCO+ solution for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

6 Refractive Index (RI) Matching  
6.1 Incubation with DBE for 3 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
6.2 Incubation with fresh DBE for 3 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

7 Mounting and Imaging Preparation  
7.1 Mount sample in DBE in a glass-bottom dish or imaging chamber.  
7.2 Store at 4 °C in the dark if imaging is not immediate.  
7.3 Image using light-sheet or confocal microscopy with appropriate filter sets for Alexa Fluor 488, Alexa Fluor 647, and DAPI.

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [CD31 (pan-endothelial), PNAd (HEV addressin), DAPI (nuclear counterstain)]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is ideal for small tissues like lymph nodes due to its rapid delipidation and excellent antibody penetration. It preserves endogenous fluorescence and allows for high-resolution imaging of deep structures. The methanol-based permeabilization enhances antigen accessibility, which is critical for HEV labeling. Using PNAd for HEVs, CD31 for pan-endothelial labeling, and DAPI for nuclear reference ensures multiplexed visualization of vascular architecture, HEV distribution, and lymphocyte zones with minimal spectral overlap and low background.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Immunolabeling  
1.1 Incubation with blocking/permeabilization solution: 0.3% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 15% (vol/vol) DMSO, 5% (vol/vol) donkey serum in PBS (pH 7.4) (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: rat anti-PNAd (1:200), rabbit anti-CD31 (1:500) in labeling buffer (0.3% Triton X-100, 0.15% BSA, 0.05% NaN₃ in PBS) (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 48 hours)  
1.3 Wash with 0.3% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS (6 × 2 hours) (Temperature: 4 °C)  
1.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-rat IgM (1:500), Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:500), and DAPI (1:10,000) in labeling buffer (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 48 hours)  
1.5 Wash with 0.3% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS (6 × 2 hours) (Temperature: 4 °C)  

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 70% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 100% methanol (2 changes) (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours total)  

3 Delipidation  
3.1 Incubation with freshly prepared 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol (2 changes) (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours total)  
3.2 Incubation with 100% DCM (2 changes) (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours total)  

4 Clearing  
4.1 Incubation with dibenzyl ether (DBE) (2 changes) (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours total)  

5 Refractive Index (RI) Matching  
5.1 Optional short-term RI matching: incubation in 100% DBE at 4 °C for imaging within 24–48 hrs  
5.2 Long-term RI stabilization: incubation in 1:1 DBE:glycerol mixture (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  

6 Imaging  
6.1 Mount in DBE or 1:1 DBE:glycerol in a custom chamber with low autofluorescence glass  
6.2 Image using light-sheet or high-penetration confocal microscopy with appropriate filter sets:  
- DAPI (Ex: 405 nm, Em: 450–470 nm)  
- Alexa Fluor 488 (Ex: 488 nm, Em: 510–530 nm)  
- Alexa Fluor 647 (Ex: 640 nm, Em: 660–700 nm)

1.5 Wash with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS (5× 24 hours). (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 5 × 24 hours)  
1.6 Incubation with DAPI (1:10,000) in PBS for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)

2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% methanol for 1 hour (2×). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [B220-Alexa Fluor 647, GL7-FITC, IB4 (凝集素)-Alexa Fluor 555, DAPI]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is ideal for whole-organ immunolabeling and optical clearing, particularly for lymphoid organs like the spleen. It preserves fluorescence well, allows deep penetration of antibodies and dyes, and is compatible with multiple labeling strategies. The methanol-based delipidation ensures rapid and effective clearing while maintaining structural integrity. B220 labels B cells specifically, GL7 marks germinal center B cells, IB4 (a lectin) labels endothelial cells and can help identify GC boundaries, and DAPI stains nuclei to assess cell density and spatial heterogeneity.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Immunolabeling  
1.1 Incubation with blocking/permeabilization solution (0.3% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, 1% BSA in PBS) (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-B220-Alexa Fluor 647 (1:200), anti-GL7-FITC (1:100), and IB4-Alexa Fluor 555 (1:100) in labeling buffer (0.3% Triton X-100, 1% BSA in PBS) (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.3 Wash with 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS (5× 2 hours each) (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 10 hours total)  

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% methanol in PBS (vol/vol) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% methanol in PBS (vol/vol) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% methanol in PBS (vol/vol) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% methanol in PBS (vol/vol) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% methanol (3× 1 hour each) (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours total)  

3 Delipidation  
3.1 Incubation with freshly prepared 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 + 5 volumes methanol) (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
3.2 Wash with 100% methanol (3× 1 hour each) (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours total)  

4 Clearing  
4.1 Incubation with iDISCO+ clearing solution (1:2 benzyl alcohol:benzyl benzoate, BABB) (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with fresh iDISCO+ solution (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Nuclear Staining  
5.1 Incubation with DAPI (1 μg/mL in iDISCO+ solution) (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
5.2 Wash with iDISCO+ solution (3× 2 hours each) (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total)  

6 Refractive Index (RI) Matching  
6.1 Incubation with dibenzyl ether (DBE) (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
6.2 Incubation with fresh DBE (Temperature: RT, Time: overnight)  

7 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
7.1 Store sample in DBE at 4 °C until imaging (avoid prolonged exposure to light)  
7.2 Mount sample in DBE-filled imaging chamber with gentle mechanical support to prevent deformation  
7.3 Image using light-sheet or high-penetration confocal microscopy with multi-channel detection for Alexa Fluor 488 (GL7), Alexa Fluor 555 (IB4), Alexa Fluor 647 (B220), and DAPI

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [B220 (PTPRC)+Alexa Fluor 647, Ki67+Alexa Fluor 555, GL7-FITC, DAPI, IB4 (凝集素)+Alexa Fluor 488]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is ideal for whole-organ immunolabeling and clearing, especially for spleen tissue, due to its excellent preservation of fluorescence and antigenicity. It allows deep penetration of antibodies and dyes in intact organs, making it suitable for 3D mapping of B cell follicles and germinal centers. The methanol-based dehydration and delipidation steps reduce light scattering while maintaining structural integrity. The selected labeling strategy enables specific identification of B cells (B220), proliferating germinal center B cells (Ki67), GC-specific marker GL7, nuclear density (DAPI), and vascular/marginal zone architecture (IB4 lectin), enabling comprehensive spatial analysis.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Immunolabeling  
1.1 Incubate spleen in blocking/permeabilization solution (0.3% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, 15% FBS in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
1.2 Incubate with primary antibodies: anti-B220 (1:200), anti-Ki67 (1:100), anti-GL7 (1:100) in labeling buffer (1% DMSO, 0.3% Triton X-100, 5% FBS in PBS) for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.3 Wash 5× with 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS, 1 hour each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubate with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-rat, Alexa Fluor 555-conjugated anti-rabbit, FITC-conjugated anti-rat, and IB4-Alexa Fluor 488 conjugate (1:500 each) in labeling buffer for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.5 Wash 5× with 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS, 1 hour each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)  

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubate in 20% MeOH in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubate in 40% MeOH in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubate in 60% MeOH in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubate in 80% MeOH in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubate in 100% MeOH twice, 1 hour each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)  

3 Delipidation  
3.1 Incubate in freshly prepared 5% H2O2 in MeOH (1:20 dilution of 30% H2O2 in MeOH) for 12–16 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12–16 hours)  

4 Rehydration  
4.1 Incubate in 80% MeOH in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.2 Incubate in 60% MeOH in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.3 Incubate in 40% MeOH in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.4 Incubate in 20% MeOH in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.5 Incubate in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

5 Nuclear Counterstaining  
5.1 Incubate with DAPI (1:10,000 in PBS) for 12–16 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12–16 hours)  
5.2 Wash 3× with PBS, 1 hour each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 1 hour)  

6 Tissue Clearing  
6.1 Incubate in iDISCO+ clearing solution (60% DMSO, 30% EtOH, 10% H2O in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Replace with fresh iDISCO+ solution and incubate for another 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

7 Refractive Index (RI) Matching  
7.1 Incubate in DBE (Dibenzyl Ether) for 6 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  
7.2 Replace with fresh DBE and incubate for 12–16 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12–16 hours)  

8 Mounting and Imaging  
8.1 Mount spleen in a custom chamber or imaging dish using DBE as mounting medium.  
8.2 Image using light-sheet or high-penetration confocal microscopy. (Objective: 10×–20× clearing-compatible immersion, Laser lines: 405, 488, 555, 647 nm)

B220 labels all B cells, GL7 specifically marks germinal centers, and DAPI labels nuclei for structural context. This combination ensures specific and high-contrast labeling of B cell follicles and germinal centers with minimal background. The decoloration and delipidation steps in iDISCO+ are more robust than in Ce3D, which will help eliminate residual heme pigments and improve signal-to-noise.

**Protocol Steps:**

1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (pH 7.4) (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (pH 7.4) (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (pH 7.4) (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (pH 7.4) (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
1.5 Incubation with chilled 100% methanol (freshly prepared) (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
1.6 Incubation with 1:5 (vol/vol) H2O2:methanol (freshly prepared) (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)

2.5 Wash with 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS (5×, 12 hours each) (Temperature: 4 °C)

**Chosen Labeling:** [CD3-Alexa Fluor 647, CD8-Alexa Fluor 594, DAPI]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is ideal for whole-organ immunolabeling and optical clearing due to its excellent preservation of fluorescent signals, compatibility with organic dyes and immunostaining, and rapid clearing of large tissues (~1 cm³). It is particularly suitable for 3D immune cell mapping in tumors. The selected labeling strategy enables specific identification of total T cells (CD3+) and cytotoxic T cells (CD8+), while DAPI provides nuclear reference for tumor architecture and cell density. This combination allows for precise spatial quantification of immune infiltration across tumor subregions.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Immunolabeling  
1.1 Incubation with blocking solution (10% (vol/vol) donkey serum, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-CD3 (1:200), anti-CD8 (1:200) in labeling buffer (1% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.05% (wt/vol) sodium azide in PBS) for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.3 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 5 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-rabbit (CD3), Alexa Fluor 594-conjugated anti-rat (CD8) at 1:500 dilution in labeling buffer for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.5 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 5 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with DAPI (1:10,000) in PBS for 12 hours to label nuclei. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
1.7 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 3 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 1 hour)  

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% methanol, 2 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)  

3 Delipidation  
3.1 Incubation with freshly prepared 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 100% DCM for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 100% DCM for an additional 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Rehydration  
4.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.5 Incubation with PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

5 Tissue Clearing  
5.1 Incubation with iDISCO+ clearing solution (20% (wt/vol) DMSO, 20% (vol/vol) NMP in 100% methanol) for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
5.2 Incubation with fresh iDISCO+ solution for an additional 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

6 Refractive Index (RI) Matching  
6.1 Incubation with RI matching solution (BABB: benzyl alcohol and benzyl benzoate at 1:2 ratio) for 3 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
6.2 Incubation with fresh BABB for an additional 3 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  

7 Mounting and Imaging Preparation  
7.1 Mount tumor in BABB-filled imaging chamber with gentle compression to minimize movement.  
7.2 Seal chamber with coverslip and allow to equilibrate for 1 hour before imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [CD3-Alexa Fluor 488, CD8-Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is ideal for whole-organ immunolabeling and optical clearing due to its excellent preservation of fluorescent proteins and compatibility with multiple antibody stainings. It is particularly suitable for 3D immunophenotyping in complex tissues like tumors. The methanol-based delipidation ensures rapid and effective clearing while maintaining antigenicity. CD3 labels all T cells, CD8 labels cytotoxic T cells, and DAPI provides nuclear contrast to define tumor core/margin boundaries and cellular density.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Tissue Preprocessing  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Whole-mount Immunolabeling  
2.1 Incubation with blocking solution (0.2% gelatin, 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
2.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-CD3 (1:200), anti-CD8 (1:200) in blocking solution. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
2.3 Wash with PBS containing 0.1% Tween-20 (PBST), 6 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total)  
2.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-rabbit, Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-rat (1:500 each) in blocking solution. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
2.5 Wash with PBST, 6 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total)  
2.6 Incubation with DAPI (1:10,000 in PBST) for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
2.7 Wash with PBST, 3 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours total)  

3 Delipidation  
3.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 100% DCM for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Repeat step 3.1–3.2 until tissue becomes visibly transparent (typically 2–3 cycles).  

4 Rehydration  
4.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.3 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.4 Incubation with PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

5 Tissue Clearing  
5.1 Incubation with iDISCO+ clearing solution (20% DMSO, 10% NMP, 70% methanol) for 12 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
5.2 Incubation with fresh iDISCO+ solution until full transparency is achieved (usually 24–48 hours). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24–48 hours)  

6 Refractive Index (RI) Matching  
6.1 Incubation with dibenzyl ether (DBE) for RI matching. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Replace with fresh DBE and continue incubation until tissue is fully cleared and refractive index is matched (12–24 hours).  

7 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
7.1 Store sample in DBE at 4 °C in the dark until imaging. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: up to 2 weeks)  
7.2 Prior to imaging, mount the sample in a custom chamber filled with DBE to maintain RI matching. (Temperature: RT)

**Justification:** iDISCO+ is ideal for whole-organ immunolabeling and optical clearing due to its excellent preservation of fluorescent signals, compatibility with multiple antibody labeling, and rapid clearing of relatively large tissues (~1 cm³). The selected labeling strategy enables specific identification of total T cells (CD3), cytotoxic T cells (CD8), vasculature (CD31), and nuclear counterstaining (DAPI), which together allow spatial mapping of immune infiltration in relation to tumor architecture.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Immunolabeling  
1.1 Incubation with blocking/permeabilization solution (0.3% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, 5% donkey serum in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: rat anti-CD3 (1:200), rabbit anti-CD8 (1:200), goat anti-CD31 (1:200) in labeling buffer (0.3% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, 1% BSA in PBS) for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.3 Wash with 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS (6 × 1 hour). (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 × 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated donkey anti-rat (1:500), Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated donkey anti-rabbit (1:500), Alexa Fluor 594-conjugated donkey anti-goat (1:500), and DAPI (1:1000) in labeling buffer for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.5 Wash with 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS (6 × 1 hour). (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 × 1 hour)  

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% methanol for 1 hour (2 changes). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)  

3 Delipidation  
3.1 Incubation with freshly prepared 66% dichloromethane (DCM), 33% methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 100% DCM for 1 hour (2 changes). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 100% ethyl cinnamate (ECi) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Tissue Clearing  
4.1 Incubation with fresh ECi containing 0.001% BHT for 12 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
4.2 Replace with fresh ECi and incubate until full transparency is achieved. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12–24 hours)  

5 Refractive Index (RI) Matching  
5.1 Incubation with RI-matching solution (benzyl alcohol:benzyl benzoate, 1:2 ratio) for 6 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  
5.2 Replace with fresh RI-matching solution and incubate for an additional 6 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

6.2 Seal chamber with silicone grease and coverslip.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 抗体标记（免疫染色）  
1.1 Incubation with blocking solution (10% (vol/vol) donkey serum, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)

1.3 Wash with PBST (0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS) for 6 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total)  
1.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-rabbit IgG and Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-rat IgG (1:500 each) in staining solution for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.5 Wash with PBST for 6 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total)  

2 脱水（Methanol梯度）  
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% methanol for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)

3.1 Incubation with 5% (vol/vol) H2O2 in methanol (freshly prepared) for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
3.2 Wash with 100% methanol for 2 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours total)

4.1 Incubation with fresh xylene for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with fresh xylene for another 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

5.1 Incubation with 1:1 mixture of xylene and dibenzyl ether (DBE) for 12 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Cx40 (Connexin 40), Cntn2 (Contactin-2), α-Actinin, IB4 (凝集素)]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is ideal for whole-organ clearing such as the heart due to its excellent tissue penetration, rapid delipidation, and strong preservation of fluorescent signals. It is particularly suitable for 3D imaging of complex structures like the Purkinje fiber network. The labeling strategy combines specific molecular markers (Cx40 and Cntn2) for Purkinje fibers, α-Actinin for cardiomyocyte structure, and IB4 for vascular reference, ensuring high specificity and contrast without interfering with clearing. This combination allows for precise 3D mapping of Purkinje fiber architecture in the intact heart.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Immunolabeling (if not already performed)  
1.1 Incubation with blocking/permeabilization solution (0.3% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, 5% donkey serum in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-Cx40 (1:500), anti-Cntn2 (1:200), and anti–α-Actinin (1:1000) in labeling buffer (0.3% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, 3% donkey serum in PBS) for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.3 Wash with 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS (6 × 24 hours). (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 6 × 24 hours)  
1.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies (e.g., Alexa Fluor 488, 594, or 647 conjugated) and IB4-Alexa Fluor 647 (for vascular labeling) at 1:500 dilution in labeling buffer for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.5 Wash with 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS (6 × 24 hours). (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 6 × 24 hours)

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% methanol for 1 hour (×2 changes). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours total)

3 Delipidation  
3.1 Incubation with freshly prepared dichloromethane (DCM)/methanol (2:1 vol/vol) for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
3.2 Replace with fresh DCM/methanol (2:1) and incubate for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
3.3 Incubation with 100% DCM for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Replace with fresh 100% DCM and incubate until tissue becomes visibly transparent (typically 1–2 hours). (Temperature: RT, Time: ~2 hours)

4 Rehydration  
4.1 Incubation with 100% methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.2 Incubation with 80% methanol in PBS for 30 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.3 Incubation with 60% methanol in PBS for 30 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.4 Incubation with 40% methanol in PBS for 30 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.5 Incubation with 20% methanol in PBS for 30 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.6 Incubation with PBS for 30 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)

5 Refractive Index (RI) Matching  
5.1 Incubation with iDISCO+ RI matching solution (DBE/Toluene, 1:2 vol/vol) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.2 Incubation with 100% dibenzyl ether (DBE) for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
5.3 Replace with fresh DBE and incubate overnight. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

6 Mounting and Imaging Preparation  
6.1 Transfer the cleared heart into a glass-bottom imaging dish or custom chamber.  
6.2 Fill chamber with fresh DBE to maintain RI matching and avoid air bubbles.  
6.3 Store at 4 °C in the dark if imaging is delayed. (Time: up to several weeks)  
6.4 Prior to imaging, equilibrate the sample at RT for 1–2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Cx40, Cntn2]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is ideal for dense, vascularized tissues like the heart due to its efficient delipidation and antigen preservation. It allows deep penetration of antibodies in whole organs and is compatible with red and far-red fluorophores, which are essential for overcoming autofluorescence from heme and myoglobin. Cx40 (Connexin40) and Cntn2 (Contactin-2) are specifically expressed in the cardiac conduction system, particularly in Purkinje fibers, making them ideal markers for reconstructing the 3D Purkinje fiber network without introducing new targets or fluorophores.

---

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Immunolabeling  
1.1 Incubation with blocking/permeabilization solution (0.3% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, 5% donkey serum in PBS) for 3 days. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-Cx40 (1:500) and anti-Cntn2 (1:200) in labeling buffer (0.3% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, 3% donkey serum in PBS) for 7 days. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 168 hours)  
1.3 Wash with 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS (6× 24 hours). (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 6 × 24 hours)  
1.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 594-conjugated anti-rabbit (1:1000) and Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-mouse (1:1000) in labeling buffer for 7 days. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 168 hours)  
1.5 Wash with 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS (6× 24 hours). (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 6 × 24 hours)

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% methanol in PBS for 6 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% methanol in PBS for 6 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% methanol in PBS for 6 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% methanol in PBS for 6 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% methanol for 2 × 20 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 40 minutes total)

3 Delipidation  
3.1 Incubation with freshly prepared dichloromethane:methanol (2:1 vol/vol) for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
3.2 Repeat step 3.1 for 2 more hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
3.3 Incubation with 100% dichloromethane for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 100% ethyl cinnamate (ECi) for clearing. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

4 Refractive Index (RI) Matching  
4.1 Incubation with 80% ECi in dichloromethane for 6 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with 100% ECi for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

5 Mounting and Imaging  
5.1 Mount sample in 100% ECi in a glass-bottom dish or custom chamber.  
5.2 Image using light-sheet or confocal microscopy with red (Alexa Fluor 594) and far-red (Alexa Fluor 647) channels.  
5.3 Perform 3D reconstruction of Purkinje fiber network using Imaris, Fiji, or similar software.

1.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-rabbit and Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-rat at 1:1000 in antibody dilution buffer. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.5 Wash with iDISCO+ wash buffer 5 times, 1 hour each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)

2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

3 Delipidation  
3.1 Incubation with freshly prepared 5% H2O2 in methanol (1:20 dilution of 30% H2O2 in methanol) overnight. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
3.2 Replace with fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol and incubate for another 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)
