**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Nephrin (NPHS1)+Alexa Fluor 555, Podocin (NPHS2)+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is ideal for whole-organ clearing of fixed tissues like kidneys, offering excellent preservation of fluorescent signals (including Alexa Fluor dyes), rapid delipidation, and compatibility with immunolabeling. The methanol-based protocol is well-suited for small organs (~10 mm size), and the high refractive index matching enables high-resolution 3D imaging of deep structures such as glomerular slit diaphragms. The combination of two slit diaphragm markers (Nephrin and Podocin) with nuclear counterstain (DAPI) allows for precise 3D structural analysis of foot process integrity and spatial correlation with glomerular morphology.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Immunolabeling  
1.1 Incubation with blocking/permeabilization solution (0.3% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, 5% donkey serum in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-Nephrin (1:200) and anti-Podocin (1:200) in labeling solution (0.3% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, 1% donkey serum in PBS) for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.3 Wash with PBS containing 0.3% Triton X-100 (PBST), 6 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total)  
1.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 555-conjugated anti-rabbit and Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-mouse (1:500 each) in labeling solution for 48 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 48 hours)  
1.5 Wash with PBST, 6 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total)  
1.6 Incubation with DAPI (1:10,000 in PBST) for 12 hours to label nuclei. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
1.7 Final wash with PBST, 3 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours total)  

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% methanol, 2 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours total)  

3 Delipidation  
3.1 Incubation with freshly prepared 5% H₂O₂ in methanol (v/v) at 4 °C for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
3.2 Incubation with 100% methanol, 2 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours total)  

4 Clearing  
4.1 Incubation with 1:1 mixture of methanol and benzyl ether (MBE) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.2 Incubation with 100% MBE, 2 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours total)  
4.3 Incubation with fresh 100% MBE for final clearing (Time: 2 hours, Temperature: RT)  

5 Refractive Index (RI) Matching  
5.1 Incubation with dibenzyl ether (DBE) for RI matching (RI ~1.56) for at least 3 hours before imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3–6 hours)  

6 Imaging and Storage  
6.1 Mount kidney in DBE-filled imaging chamber and image using light-sheet or high-penetration confocal microscopy.  
6.2 Store cleared tissue in DBE at 4 °C in the dark for up to several weeks with retained fluorescence.

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Podocin (NPHS2), IB4, DAPI]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is ideal for whole-organ clearing such as kidneys due to its excellent optical clearing, good preservation of endogenous fluorescence and antigenicity, and compatibility with immunolabeling. It is particularly suitable for 3D imaging of complex structures like glomeruli. Podocin (NPHS2) is a specific marker for podocytes and labels the slit diaphragm; IB4 effectively labels endothelial surfaces of glomerular capillaries; DAPI is used for nuclear counterstaining. This combination enables precise 3D mapping of podocyte-cappillary spatial relationships and detection of structural heterogeneity in glomerular morphology.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Tissue Preprocessing  
1.1 Incubation with 100% methanol for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with chilled 5% H2O2 in methanol for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  

2 Whole-mount Immunolabeling  
2.1 Incubation with blocking/permeabilization solution (0.2% gelatin, 0.5% Triton X-100, 1.5 M NaCl in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
2.2 Incubation with primary antibody: Rabbit anti-Podocin (NPHS2) at 1:500 dilution in labeling buffer (0.2% gelatin, 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS) for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
2.3 Wash with PBS containing 0.3% Triton X-100 (PBST), 6 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total)  
2.4 Incubation with secondary antibody: Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-rabbit IgG at 1:1000 in labeling buffer for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
2.5 Wash with PBST, 6 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total)  
2.6 Incubation with IB4 conjugated to Alexa Fluor 555 at 1:500 dilution in labeling buffer for 48 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 48 hours)  
2.7 Wash with PBST, 6 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total)  
2.8 Incubation with DAPI (1:1000 in PBST) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
2.9 Wash with PBST, 6 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total)  

3 Tissue Optical Clearing  
3.1 Incubation with 50% dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 100% DCM for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 100% DCM until tissue becomes transparent (typically 1–2 hours). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours total)  

4 Refractive Index (RI) Matching  
4.1 Incubation with dibenzyl ether (DBE) for RI matching. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  

5 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
5.1 Mount sample in DBE in a custom chamber suitable for light-sheet or confocal microscopy.  
5.2 Store in dark at RT if imaging is not immediate. (Temperature: RT, Time: up to 2 weeks)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC-LS  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Nephrin (NPHS1)+Alexa Fluor 488, Podocin (NPHS2)+Alexa Fluor 555, DAPI]  
**Justification:** CUBIC-LS (CUBIC with extended Lipid Solvent treatment) is selected for its superior optical clearing and refractive index homogenization in complex organs like the kidney, especially when long-term preservation of fluorescent signals (Alexa Fluor dyes) is required. The original CUBIC protocol was insufficient due to short incubation and single-phase lipid removal. CUBIC-LS improves lipid removal and RI matching across both cortex and medulla, enabling uniform transparency. The labeling strategy targets two key slit diaphragm proteins (Nephrin and Podocin) with distinct Alexa Fluor dyes and uses DAPI for nuclear counterstain, all compatible with CUBIC-based clearing. This combination supports high-resolution 3D imaging, precise glomerular boundary detection, and quantitative volumetric analysis across the entire kidney.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Immunolabeling Completion (if not already performed)  
1.1 Incubate kidney in blocking solution (10% normal goat serum, 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
1.2 Incubate with primary antibodies: Nephrin (NPHS1) and Podocin (NPHS2) diluted in blocking solution (1:200 each) for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.3 Wash 3× with 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS, 2 hours each. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 6 hours total)  
1.4 Incubate with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-rabbit and Alexa Fluor 555-conjugated anti-mouse (1:500 dilution) + DAPI (1:10,000) in blocking solution for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.5 Wash 3× with 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS, 2 hours each. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 6 hours total)  

2 CUBIC-L Treatment (Lipid Removal)  
2.1 Incubate with CUBIC-L reagent (10% wt/vol N-butyldiethanolamine, 5% wt/vol polyethylene glycol mono-p-isooctylphenyl ether (Triton X-100), 25% vol/vol urea in water) at 37 °C for 48 hours. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 48 hours)  
2.2 Replace with fresh CUBIC-L reagent and incubate for another 48 hours. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 48 hours)  

3 Washing  
3.1 Wash with PBS containing 0.1% Triton X-100, 6 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  
3.2 Repeat wash step 2 more times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours total)  

4 CUBIC-LS Treatment (Extended Lipid Solvent Clearing)  
4.1 Incubate with CUBIC-LS solution (CUBIC-L supplemented with 10% vol/vol methanol) at 37 °C for 48 hours. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 48 hours)  
4.2 Replace with fresh CUBIC-LS and incubate for another 48 hours. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 48 hours)  

5 Refractive Index (RI) Matching  
5.1 Incubate with CUBIC-R1 solution (10% wt/vol sucrose, 25% wt/vol urea, 20% vol/vol glycerol in water) at RT for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
5.2 Replace with CUBIC-R2 solution (25% wt/vol sucrose, 30% wt/vol urea, 40% vol/vol glycerol in water) and incubate for 48 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)  
5.3 Replace with CUBIC-R3 solution (30% wt/vol sucrose, 30% wt/vol urea, 60% vol/vol glycerol in water) and incubate until full transparency is achieved (up to 96 hours). (Temperature: RT, Time: up to 96 hours)  

6 Final Washing and Mounting  
6.1 Wash with PBS containing 0.1% Triton X-100 for 6 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  
6.2 Post-fix with 4% PFA in PBS for 2 hours to stabilize fluorescent signals. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
6.3 Wash with PBS for 6 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  

7 Mounting and Imaging Preparation  
7.1 Incubate with final RI matching solution (80% glycerol in water, RI ~1.45–1.47) for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
7.2 Mount kidney in RI-matched chamber for light-sheet or high-penetration confocal imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: imaging session duration)

**Chosen Labeling:** [CK19 (胆管) + Alexa Fluor 488, Collagen IV + Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is ideal for large, fixed tissues like whole mouse livers due to its excellent optical clearing efficiency, compatibility with multiple fluorescent markers, and preservation of endogenous fluorescence. It is particularly suitable for 3D imaging of complex networks such as bile duct trees. The labeling strategy uses CK19 to specifically label bile duct epithelium, Collagen IV to highlight basement membranes for structural context, and DAPI for nuclear counterstain. This combination ensures high-resolution visualization of bile duct morphology and spatial relationships across the entire liver lobe.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Immunolabeling (if not already performed)  
1.1 Incubation with blocking/permeabilization solution (0.3% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, 5% donkey serum in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-CK19 (1:500) and anti-Collagen IV (1:1000) in labeling solution (0.3% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, 3% donkey serum in PBS) for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.3 Wash with PBS containing 0.3% Triton X-100 (6 × 1 hour). (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 × 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-mouse and Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-rabbit (1:1000) with DAPI (1:10,000) in labeling solution for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.5 Wash with PBS containing 0.3% Triton X-100 (6 × 1 hour). (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 × 1 hour)  

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% methanol for 1 hour (×2). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)  

3 Delipidation  
3.1 Incubation with freshly prepared 66% dichloromethane (DCM), 33% methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 100% DCM for 1 hour (×2). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 100% ethyl cinnamate (ECi) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Tissue Clearing  
4.1 Incubation with fresh ECi for 12 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with ECi containing 0.001% methyl red (optional for background suppression) for 12 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  

5 Refractive Index (RI) Matching  
5.1 Incubation with RI-matching solution (benzyl alcohol:benzyl benzoate, 1:2 vol/vol, RI ~1.56) for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

6 Mounting and Imaging Preparation  
6.1 Transfer liver into a custom imaging chamber compatible with light-sheet or two-photon microscopy.  
6.2 Fill chamber with RI-matching solution to minimize refractive index mismatch and reduce spherical aberration.  
6.3 Image using light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM) or two-photon microscopy with appropriate filter sets for Alexa Fluor 488, Alexa Fluor 647, and DAPI.  

7 Storage (if needed)  
7.1 Store cleared and labeled liver in RI-matching solution at 4 °C in the dark. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: up to several weeks)  
7.2 For long-term storage (>1 month), replace RI-matching solution with fresh solution every 2–4 weeks.

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [CK19 (导管), CK7, DAPI, CD31]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is highly suitable for whole-organ clearing such as mouse liver, offering excellent preservation of fluorescent signals, deep penetration, and compatibility with multiple immunolabeling steps. It is particularly effective for 3D imaging of complex structures like bile duct networks. The methanol-based delipidation efficiently clears lipids while maintaining antigenicity for antibody labeling. CK19 and CK7 are well-established markers for bile duct epithelium and together provide robust identification of the biliary tree. CD31 serves as a vascular reference to distinguish blood vessels from bile ducts, and DAPI provides nuclear counterstain for structural orientation and segmentation.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Immunolabeling  
1.1 Incubation with blocking solution (10% (vol/vol) donkey serum, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-CK19 (1:500), anti-CK7 (1:1000), anti-CD31 (1:200) in labeling buffer (1% (vol/vol) donkey serum, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS) for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.3 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 6 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 × 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 488 anti-mouse, Alexa Fluor 594 anti-rabbit, Alexa Fluor 647 anti-rat (all 1:1000) in labeling buffer for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.5 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 6 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 × 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with DAPI (1:10,000 in PBS) for 12 hours for nuclear staining. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

3 Delipidation  
3.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane:methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 100% dichloromethane for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 100% dichloromethane for additional 1 hour to ensure full delipidation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Rehydration  
4.1 Incubation with 1:1 (vol/vol) dichloromethane:methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.2 Incubation with 100% methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.4 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.5 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.6 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.7 Incubation with PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

5 Refractive Index (RI) Matching  
5.1 Incubation with iDISCO+ RI matching solution (DBE:Toluene = 1:1) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.2 Incubation with 100% dibenzyl ether (DBE) for 12 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
5.3 Incubation with fresh 100% DBE for 12 hours to complete RI matching. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  

6 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
6.1 Mount sample in custom imaging chamber compatible with light-sheet or confocal microscopy using DBE as immersion medium.  
6.2 Store in 100% DBE at 4 °C if imaging is not immediate. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: up to 2 weeks)

CK19 specifically labels bile duct epithelium, IB4 can label vascular endothelium in the portal tracts, and DAPI provides nuclear counterstain for structural orientation. This combination enables precise 3D mapping of bile duct networks and their spatial relationship to portal tracts.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Immunolabeling  
1.1 Incubation with blocking solution (10% (vol/vol) donkey serum, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-CK19 (1:500), IB4 (1:200, conjugated or unconjugated), and DAPI (1:10,000 if added during labeling) in labeling buffer (3% (vol/vol) donkey serum, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS) for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.3 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 6 times for 2 hours each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours total)  
1.4 Incubation with secondary antibody: Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-mouse/rabbit IgG (1:1000) in labeling buffer for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.5 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 6 times for 2 hours each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours total)  

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% methanol twice for 1 hour each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours total)  

3 Delipidation  
3.1 Incubation with freshly prepared 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 100% DCM for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 100% DCM for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Repeat step 3.3 until tissue becomes visibly transparent. (Temperature: RT, Time: variable)  

4 Rehydration  
4.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) DCM in methanol for 30 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 0.5 hour)  
4.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 30 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 0.5 hour)  
4.3 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 30 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 0.5 hour)  
4.4 Incubation with 15% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 30 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 0.5 hour)  
4.5 Incubation with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

5 Tissue Clearing  
5.1 Incubation with iDISCO+ clearing solution (20% (wt/vol) DMSO, 5% (wt/vol) N-Benzyl-D-glucamine, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS) for 24–48 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)  
5.2 Replace with fresh iDISCO+ solution and incubate for another 24–48 hours until full transparency. (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)

6.1 Incubation with RI matching solution (DBE:methanol = 2:1 vol/vol) for 6 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  
6.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE) for 12 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
6.3 Replace with fresh DBE and incubate for 12–24 hours before imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

7 Imaging and Storage  
7.1 Mount sample in DBE in a custom chamber suitable for light-sheet or high-magnification confocal imaging.  
7.2 Store sample in 100% DBE at 4 °C in the dark for long-term preservation. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: indefinite)

**Chosen Method:** PEGASOS (修正版)  
**Chosen Labeling:** [CK19 (导管), CK7]  
**Justification:** PEGASOS 是一种基于有机溶剂的透明化方法，适用于完整器官的深层成像，尤其适合富含血液的组织。通过延长脱色和甲醇梯度处理时间，可显著改善肝脏脱血和透明效果。CK19 和 CK7 是胆管上皮细胞的特异性角蛋白标记物，双标可全面勾勒胆管树结构，增强信号对比度和完整性。抗体标记在修正后的 PEGASOS 流程中可良好保留，且与后续折射率匹配兼容。

**Protocol Steps:**

1 组织透明化处理  
1.1 Incubation with 100% methanol containing 5% H2O2 at 4 °C for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with methanol gradient: 75%, 50%, 25% in PBS-T (0.3% Triton X-100), each for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours total)  
1.3 Incubation with PBS-T containing 0.3% Triton X-100 for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Blocking with 10% normal goat serum in PBS-T for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
1.5 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-CK19 (1:500) and anti-CK7 (1:500) in PBS-T with 5% serum for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.6 Washing with PBS-T (0.3% Triton X-100) for 6 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total)  
1.7 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 488 anti-rabbit and Alexa Fluor 647 anti-mouse in PBS-T with 5% serum for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.8 Washing with PBS-T (0.3% Triton X-100) for 6 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total)  

2 脱色处理  
2.1 Incubation with chilled 100% methanol containing 5% H2O2 for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
2.2 Incubation with 75% methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 50% methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with 25% methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

3 脱脂与透明化  
3.1 Incubation with 100% dichloromethane (DCM) for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
3.2 Incubation with 1:1 DCM:PEGASOS solution (PEGASOS: 70% v/v glycerol, 2.5% w/v PVP, 2.5% w/v PVA, 0.1% w/v toluidine blue O) for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
3.3 Incubation with 100% PEGASOS solution for 48 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)  

4 折射率均一化  
4.1 Incubation with RI matching solution (80% glycerol, 20% PEG 400 in PBS) for 48 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)  

5 成像前保存与处理  
5.1 Incubation with final RI matching solution (90% glycerol, 10% PEG 400, RI ~1.46) for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
5.2 Mounting in RI-matched chamber with 90% glycerol solution for light-sheet or confocal imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: immediate use or store at 4 °C for up to 2 weeks)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [α-SMA+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI, F-Actin+Alexa Fluor 488]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is ideal for whole-organ clearing such as lung lobes, offering rapid delipidation while preserving fluorescence from Alexa Fluor dyes and endogenous fluorophores. It is particularly suitable for 3D imaging of complex, air-filled organs like the lung, where uniform clearing is challenging. The use of α-SMA specifically labels smooth muscle, while F-actin provides structural context of the airway wall. DAPI labels nuclei to aid in anatomical orientation and segmentation. This combination enables high-resolution 3D visualization and quantification of airway smooth muscle remodeling across all airway generations in the asthma model.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Immunolabeling (if not already performed)  
1.1 Incubation with blocking/permeabilization solution (0.3% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, 5% donkey serum in PBS) (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with primary antibody: anti-α-SMA (1:500) in labeling buffer (0.3% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, 1% BSA in PBS) (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.3 Wash with PBS containing 0.3% Triton X-100 (6 × 1 hour at RT)  
1.4 Incubation with secondary antibody: Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-mouse IgG (1:1000) and Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated Phalloidin (1:200) in labeling buffer (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 48 hours)  
1.5 Wash with PBS containing 0.3% Triton X-100 (6 × 1 hour at RT)  
1.6 Incubation with DAPI (1:10,000) in PBS for nuclear labeling (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
1.7 Final wash with PBS (3 × 30 minutes at RT)

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% methanol in PBS (vol/vol) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% methanol in PBS (vol/vol) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% methanol in PBS (vol/vol) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% methanol in PBS (vol/vol) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% methanol (3 × 1 hour) (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours total)

3 Delipidation  
3.1 Incubation with freshly prepared dichloromethane (DCM)/methanol (2:1 vol/vol) (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
3.2 Incubation with fresh DCM/methanol (1:2 vol/vol) (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
3.3 Incubation with fresh DCM (2 × 1 hour) (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours total)  
3.4 Incubation with DCM and 2% (vol/vol) triethylamine (TEA) to reduce autofluorescence (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4 Rehydration  
4.1 Incubation with DCM/methanol (1:2 vol/vol) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.2 Incubation with methanol (100%) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.3 Incubation with 80% methanol in PBS (vol/vol) (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.4 Incubation with 60% methanol in PBS (vol/vol) (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.5 Incubation with 40% methanol in PBS (vol/vol) (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.6 Incubation with 20% methanol in PBS (vol/vol) (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.7 Incubation with PBS (3 × 30 minutes) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours total)

5 Tissue Clearing  
5.1 Incubation with iDISCO+ clearing solution (DBE:Tween-20, 2:1 vol/vol) (Temperature: RT, Time: 24–48 hours or until fully transparent)

6 Refractive Index (RI) Matching  
6.1 Incubation with RI-matching solution (100% dibutyl phthalate, DBP) (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Optional: Replace with fresh DBP for final imaging clarity (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

7 Mounting and Imaging  
7.1 Mount sample in custom chamber or glass-bottom dish filled with DBP  
7.2 Image using light-sheet or high-magnification confocal microscopy with water or silicone immersion objectives optimized for cleared tissue  
7.3 Acquire z-stacks across entire lung lobe volume for 3D reconstruction and quantitative analysis of α-SMA+ smooth muscle layers across all airway orders

**Chosen Labeling:** [α-SMA, Desmin]  
**Justification:** PEGASOS 是一种适用于完整肺叶的透明化方法，具有良好的组织结构保留性和较高的透明均一性，尤其适合结合三维成像分析。通过延长脱脂时间并恢复去色素步骤，可显著改善肺组织内部透明不均的问题，并增强平滑肌标记信号的保留与显影。选用 α-SMA 和 Desmin 作为双平滑肌标记，可分别标记平滑肌细胞骨架和中间丝结构，全面反映气道平滑肌重塑的分布、厚度和连续性。

---

**Protocol Steps:**

1 组织透明化处理  
1.1 恢复去色素步骤：将肺叶样本置于预冷的 5% H₂O₂ / 甲醇溶液中避光孵育。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 小时)  
1.2 梯度甲醇脱水：依次在 20%、40%、60%、80%、100% 甲醇/PBS 溶液中各孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 每步 2 小时)  
1.3 脱脂处理：将样本置于 66% 甲醇 / 33% 乙醚 / 1% Triton X-100 溶液中避光孵育。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 小时 × 3 次更换)  
1.4 洗涤：依次在 80%、60%、40%、20% 甲醇/PBS 溶液中各孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 每步 2 小时)  

2 免疫荧光标记  
2.1 封闭：样本在含 10% 正常山羊血清、1% Triton X-100 的 PBS 溶液中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 小时)  
2.2 一抗孵育：加入 α-SMA（1:200）和 Desmin（1:100）抗体混合液，在含 1% Triton X-100 的 PBS 中孵育。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 小时)  
2.3 洗涤：在含 0.3% Triton X-100 的 PBS 中洗涤 3 次。(Temperature: RT, Time: 每次 4 小时)  
2.4 二抗孵育：加入 Alexa Fluor 488 和 Alexa Fluor 594 标记的二抗混合液（1:500），在含 1% Triton X-100 的 PBS 中孵育。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 小时)  
2.5 洗涤：在含 0.3% Triton X-100 的 PBS 中洗涤 3 次。(Temperature: RT, Time: 每次 4 小时)  

3 折射率匹配  
3.1 初级折射率匹配：样本在 50% PEGASOS-S1（含 50% 甘油、20% 蔗糖、0.1% Tween-20）中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 小时)  
3.2 深度折射率匹配：样本在 100% PEGASOS-S1 中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 小时 × 2 次更换)  
3.3 终极折射率匹配：样本在 PEGASOS-S2（含 80% 甘油、20% 蔗糖、0.1% Tween-20，RI ≈ 1.47）中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 48 小时)  

4 成像前处理与保存  
4.1 样本转移至含 1× PBS 的成像皿中，加入低熔点琼脂糖固定样本。(Temperature: RT, Time: 凝固后立即使用或保存)  
4.2 如需长期保存，可将样本置于 PEGASOS-S2 溶液中，密封后于 4 ℃ 避光保存。(保存时间：最长 3 个月)  
4.3 成像前使用 PBS 洗涤 1 次以去除表面残留透明剂。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 小时)

This combination supports high-resolution 3D reconstruction and quantification of β-cell mass, islet number, and spatial distribution.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Immunolabeling (if not already performed)  
1.1 Incubate fixed pancreas in blocking solution: 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 5% (vol/vol) donkey serum, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
1.2 Incubate with primary antibody: Guinea pig anti-Insulin (1:500) in labeling solution (5% DMSO, 3% donkey serum, 0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.3 Wash 3× 1 hour each with PBS containing 0.1% Tween-20. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)  
1.4 Incubate with secondary antibody: Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-Guinea pig IgG (1:500) and DAPI (1:10,000) in labeling solution. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.5 Wash 3× 1 hour each with PBS containing 0.1% Tween-20. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)  

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubate in 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for gradual dehydration. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubate in 40% methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubate in 60% methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubate in 80% methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubate in 100% methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
2.6 Replace with fresh 100% methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

3 Delipidation  
3.1 Incubate in freshly prepared 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) / 33% methanol solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Replace with fresh 66% DCM / 33% methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubate in 100% DCM until tissue becomes visibly transparent (typically 1–2 hours). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

4 Rehydration  
4.1 Incubate in 66% methanol / 33% PBS for 30 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.2 Incubate in 40% methanol / 60% PBS for 30 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.3 Incubate in 20% methanol / 80% PBS for 30 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.4 Incubate in 100% PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

5.1 Incubate in iDISCO+ RI matching solution (DBE/Toluene, 1:1 vol/vol) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

6.1 Transfer pancreas into a glass-bottom dish or imaging chamber.  
6.2 Cover with DBE/Toluene (1:1) to maintain RI matching during imaging.  
6.3 Image using light-sheet or confocal microscopy optimized for whole-organ 3D imaging.

7.1 Store cleared and labeled pancreas in DBE/Toluene (1:1) at RT in the dark. (Temperature: RT, Time: up to several weeks)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Insulin-Alexa Fluor 647, Glucagon-Alexa Fluor 488, PDX1-6E10, DAPI]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is ideal for whole-organ clearing such as the pancreas due to its excellent preservation of fluorescent proteins and immunolabeling signals, compatibility with 3D imaging, and relatively fast clearing time. It is particularly suitable for tissues of this size (~15 mm × 8 mm × 3 mm) and allows for deep penetration of antibodies. The labeling strategy includes Insulin-Alexa Fluor 647 for β-cell identification, Glucagon-Alexa Fluor 488 for α-cells, PDX1-6E10 for nuclear co-localization in β-cells to enhance identification reliability, and DAPI as a nuclear counterstain for structural reference without being used as the sole quantification marker.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Immunolabeling (if not already performed)  
1.1 Incubation with blocking/permeabilization solution (0.3% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, 5% donkey serum in PBS) (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: Insulin (Alexa Fluor 647 conjugated), Glucagon (Alexa Fluor 488 conjugated), and PDX1 (6E10 clone) diluted in iDISCO+ antibody buffer (0.3% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, 3% donkey serum in PBS) (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.3 Wash with iDISCO+ wash buffer (0.3% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO in PBS) (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 6 × 24 hours)  

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

3 Delipidation  
3.1 Incubation with freshly prepared 5% H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol) at 4 °C (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
3.2 Incubation with 100% dichloromethane (DCM) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 1:1 DCM:MACS-R2 (v/v) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with MACS-R2 (40% vol/vol MXDA, 50% w/v sorbitol, RI = 1.51) (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  

4 Refractive Index (RI) Matching  
4.1 Incubation with DBE (Dibenzyl Ether) (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with fresh DBE for final RI matching (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Mounting and Imaging Preparation  
5.1 Transfer the cleared pancreas into a glass-bottom imaging dish or chamber slide  
5.2 Cover with DBE to maintain RI matching during imaging  
5.3 Store at 4 °C in the dark if imaging is not immediate (sample can be stored for up to 2 weeks in DBE without significant signal loss)  

6 Imaging  
6.1 Perform 3D imaging using a light-sheet fluorescence microscope or a high-penetration confocal microscope  
6.2 Use 405 nm (DAPI), 488 nm (Glucagon), 638 nm (Insulin), and 561 nm (PDX1-6E10) excitation lasers for multichannel acquisition  
6.3 Acquire z-stacks with 5–10 μm step size for whole pancreas coverage  

7 Post-Imaging Processing  
7.1 Use Imaris, Fiji, or similar software for 3D reconstruction and segmentation  
7.2 Quantify insulin+ β-cell volume, islet number, size, and distribution across pancreatic regions (head, body, tail)  
7.3 Correlate PDX1 signal with insulin+ cells to improve β-cell identification accuracy  
7.4 Analyze spatial co-localization of hormone products and transcription factors for developmental/endocrine profiling

**Chosen Method:** ScaleS  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Insulin+Alexa Fluor 488, PDX1+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]  
**Justification:** ScaleS is a sorbitol-based, non-electrophoretic tissue clearing method that preserves both fluorescence and antigenicity, making it ideal for post-fixed soft tissues like the pancreas. It minimizes structural deformation and maintains fine cellular architecture, which is critical for preserving fragile islet morphology. Compared to CUBIC, ScaleS avoids harsh delipidation conditions (e.g., high detergent or base concentrations), which likely caused islet disruption and signal loss in your prior attempt. The selected labeling strategy targets insulin (β-cell hormone product) and PDX1 (a key transcription factor in β-cell identity), enabling dual detection with high specificity. Alexa Fluor dyes are compatible with ScaleS and offer bright, photostable signals. DAPI is used for nuclear counterstain and volumetric normalization.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Immunolabeling Completion (if not already performed)  
1.1 Incubation with blocking solution (10% normal donkey serum, 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: Guinea pig anti-Insulin (1:500) and Rabbit anti-PDX1 (1:200) in labeling buffer (1% NDS, 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS) for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.3 Wash with PBS containing 0.1% Triton X-100 (6 × 1 hour) (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total)  
1.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-guinea pig and Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-rabbit (1:500 each) in labeling buffer for 48 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 48 hours)  
1.5 Wash with PBS containing 0.1% Triton X-100 (6 × 1 hour) (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total)  
1.6 Incubation with DAPI (1:10,000 in PBS) for 12 hours for nuclear labeling. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
1.7 Final wash with PBS (3 × 1 hour) (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours total)  

2 ScaleS Clearing  
2.1 Incubation with ScaleS1 solution (40% w/v urea, 10% w/v polyethylene glycol diglycidyl ether (PEGE), 10% dimethyl sulfoxide in 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS) for 48 hours. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 48 hours)  
2.2 Replace with fresh ScaleS1 solution and incubate for another 48 hours. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 48 hours)  

3 Refractive Index (RI) Matching  
3.1 Incubation with ScaleS2 solution (46% w/v sorbitol, 15% w/v PEGE, 10% DMSO in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
3.2 Incubation with ScaleS3 solution (60% w/v sorbitol, 30% glycerol in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
3.3 Incubation with ScaleS4 solution (80% w/v sorbitol in PBS) for 24–48 hours until full optical clearing is achieved. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24–48 hours)  

4 Mounting and Imaging Preparation  
4.1 Mount the cleared pancreas in a chamber filled with ScaleS4 solution.  
4.2 Seal the chamber to prevent dehydration during long-term imaging.  
4.3 Proceed with light-sheet or high-resolution confocal microscopy for whole-organ imaging.  

5 Post-Imaging Storage  
5.1 Store the sample in ScaleS4 solution at 4 °C in the dark for up to several months with minimal signal loss.

The use of TH labeling specifically identifies sympathetic nerve fibers (as TH is a key enzyme in catecholamine synthesis), CD31 labels vasculature for spatial reference, and DAPI stains nuclei to provide tissue architecture context. 1.6 Incubation with DAPI (1:10,000) in PBS for nuclear staining  
(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
1.7 Final wash with PBS (3 × 30 minutes at RT)

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS  
(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS  
(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS  
(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS  
(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% methanol  
(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
2.6 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH)  
(Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)

(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.5 Incubation with PBS

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [TH (tyrosine hydroxylase)+Alexa Fluor 488, NPY+Alexa Fluor 594, DAPI]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is ideal for whole-mount immunolabeling and clearing of adipose tissues due to its excellent preservation of fluorescent proteins and compatibility with multiple antibody labeling. It allows deep penetration and high-resolution imaging in tissues up to 1 cm thick, which fits the size of the white adipose pad. The methanol-based dehydration and BABB clearing provide high transparency and optical homogeneity. The selected markers TH and NPY specifically label noradrenergic and peptidergic sympathetic fibers respectively, enabling clear distinction between the two fiber types. DAPI is used for nuclear counterstain to define tissue architecture.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Immunolabeling  
1.1 Incubation with blocking solution (10% (vol/vol) donkey serum, 0.3% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-TH (1:500) and anti-NPY (1:500) in labeling buffer (1% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.01% (wt/vol) heparin in PBS) for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.3 Wash with PBS containing 0.1% (vol/vol) Tween-20 (PBT), 6 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total)  
1.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-rabbit and Alexa Fluor 594-conjugated anti-goat (1:1000 each) in labeling buffer for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.5 Wash with PBT, 6 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total)  
1.6 Incubation with DAPI (1:10,000) in PBS for 12 hours for nuclear staining. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.6 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Delipidation and Clearing  
3.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) methanol/BABB solution for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 100% BABB (benzyl alcohol/benzyl benzoate, 1:1 vol/vol) for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
3.3 Incubation with fresh 100% BABB for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

4 Refractive Index (RI) Matching  
4.1 Incubation with RI matching solution (100% BABB) for 12 hours prior to imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  

5 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
5.1 Mount sample in custom chamber filled with BABB to prevent drying and ensure optical clarity.  
5.2 Store sample in sealed container with BABB at RT for long-term preservation.  
5.3 Image using light-sheet or high-magnification confocal microscopy with immersion BABB.

1.7 Wash with 0.2% PBST 6 times over 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)

The methanol-based dehydration and delipidation steps are critical for removing lipids that cause light scattering, and the gradual RI matching ensures optical homogeneity. **Protocol Steps:**

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [IB4-Alexa Fluor 647, Collagen IV, DAPI]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is ideal for whole-organ clearing, especially for tissues like placenta with complex vasculature. It provides excellent optical clearing, preserves fluorescence well, and is compatible with intravascular labeling. IB4-Alexa Fluor 647 directly labels functional vascular endothelium and is perfused pre-fixation to label perfused vessels. Collagen IV outlines vascular basement membranes, enhancing structural contrast. DAPI labels nuclei for spatial orientation and cellular density. This combination enables high-resolution 3D imaging of vascular trees, including branching patterns, connectivity, and spatial coverage.

---

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Vascular Labeling (Pre-Clearing)  
1.1 Perfusion of IB4-Alexa Fluor 647 (1:100 in PBS) via left ventricle to label functional vascular lumen. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 minutes)  
1.2 Post-fixation with 4% PFA in PBS for 2 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 2 hours)  
1.3 Wash with PBS (3× 30 minutes) to remove unbound lectin. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours total)

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3 Delipidation  
3.1 Incubation with freshly prepared 66% dichloromethane (DCM)/33% methanol solution for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Repeat step 3.1 once. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Wash with 100% methanol (2× 30 minutes). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour total)

4 Rehydration  
4.1 Incubation with 80% methanol in PBS for 30 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.2 Incubation with 60% methanol in PBS for 30 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.3 Incubation with 40% methanol in PBS for 30 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.4 Incubation with 20% methanol in PBS for 30 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.5 Incubation with PBS for 30 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)

5 Immunolabeling  
5.1 Incubation with blocking solution (10% DMSO, 5% donkey serum, 0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
5.2 Incubation with primary antibody: Collagen IV (1:200 in blocking solution) for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
5.3 Wash with PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 (5× 1 hour). (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 hours total)  
5.4 Incubation with secondary antibody: Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:500) for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
5.5 Wash with PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 (5× 1 hour). (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 hours total)  
5.6 Incubation with DAPI (1:10,000 in PBS) for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
5.7 Wash with PBS (3× 1 hour). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours total)

6 Tissue Clearing  
6.1 Incubation with iDISCO+ clearing solution (20% DMSO, 20% N,N-dimethylformamide in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Incubation with fresh iDISCO+ solution for another 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

7 Refractive Index (RI) Matching  
7.1 Incubation with DBE (Dibenzyl Ether) for RI matching. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
7.2 Replace with fresh DBE and incubate for another 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

8 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
8.1 Mount sample in a glass-bottom dish or imaging chamber using 1% low-melting agarose in PBS to prevent movement during imaging.  
8.2 Store in DBE at 4 °C in the dark until imaging. (Time: up to 2 weeks)  
8.3 Image using light-sheet or confocal microscopy with appropriate filters for Alexa Fluor 488, Alexa Fluor 647, and DAPI.

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [CD31 (PECAM1), IB4 (凝集素)]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is well-suited for whole-organ clearing and provides excellent optical transparency with good preservation of fluorescent proteins and immunolabeling. Given the tissue’s small size and high blood content, iDISCO+’s methanol-based dehydration and delipidation effectively clear blood pigments and improve light penetration. CD31 labels vascular endothelial cells, while IB4 labels functional vascular lumina, enabling dual visualization of vessel architecture and perfusion patterns. Extended incubation times and optimized methanol gradients enhance deep penetration and uniform labeling in thick, blood-rich tissues like the placenta.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Tissue Washing  
1.1 Incubation with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 (PBST) for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
1.2 Repeat wash with fresh PBST for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  

2 Antigen Retrieval (Optional for Enhanced Labeling Penetration)  
2.1 Incubation with 0.1 M Tris-HCl pH 9.0 at 60 °C for 30 minutes. (Temperature: 60 °C, Time: 30 minutes)  
2.2 Cool to RT slowly, then wash with PBST for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

3 Blocking  
3.1 Incubation with PBST containing 10% (vol/vol) DMSO and 5% (wt/vol) BSA for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  

4 Primary Antibody and Lectin Labeling  
4.1 Incubation with CD31 (PECAM1) primary antibody diluted 1:200 and IB4 diluted 1:100 in blocking solution for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  

5 Washing  
5.1 Wash with PBST (3 × 12 hours). (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours each)  

6 Secondary Antibody Labeling  
6.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-rat IgG and Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated streptavidin (for IB4) diluted 1:500 in blocking solution for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  

7 Washing  
7.1 Wash with PBST (3 × 12 hours). (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours each)  

8 Dehydration  
8.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
8.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
8.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
8.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
8.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  

9 Delipidation  
9.1 Incubation with 100% dichloromethane (DCM) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) DCM:methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 100% DCM for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Rehydration  
10.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
10.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
10.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
10.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
10.5 Incubation with PBST for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  

11 Tissue Clearing  
11.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE) in methanol for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with 100% DBE for 48 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)  

12 Refractive Index Matching  
12.1 Incubation with fresh 100% DBE for 24 hours prior to imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

13 Storage and Imaging  
13.1 Store in 100% DBE at RT in the dark until imaging.  
13.2 Image using light-sheet or confocal microscopy with appropriate excitation/emission filters for Alexa Fluor 488 and Alexa Fluor 647.

It allows high-resolution 3D imaging of deep tissue structures using light-sheet or confocal microscopy. The selected labeling strategy enables precise identification of germ cell populations (via RNA helicase), meiotic stages (via SYCP3), and nuclear morphology (DAPI), which are essential for analyzing the spatial organization of the seminiferous epithelium and spermatogenic waves.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Tissue Optical Clearing  
1.1 Incubation with methanol series (20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100%) in PBS-T (0.1% Tween-20) over 5 days (1 day per step). (Temperature: RT, Time per step: 24 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with chilled 100% methanol for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
1.3 Incubation with 1:1 methanol/hexane for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
1.4 Incubation with 100% hexane for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 1:1 hexane/dibenzyl ether (DBE) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with 100% DBE for 2–3 hours until tissue becomes transparent. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2–3 hours)  

2 Immunolabeling (if not performed prior to clearing)  
2.1 Rehydration with 1:1 DBE/hexane (1 hour), then 1:1 methanol/hexane (2 hours), followed by methanol series (80%, 60%, 40%, 20%) in PBS-T. (Temperature: RT, Time per step: 1–2 hours)  
2.2 Blocking in PBS-T containing 0.3% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, 5% donkey serum for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
2.3 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-RNA helicase (e.g., Ddx4/Vasa, 1:500 dilution), anti-SYCP3 (1:200 dilution) in blocking solution. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 5–7 days)  
2.4 Wash with PBS-T (0.1% Tween-20) 5 times over 2 days. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time per wash: 6–8 hours)  
2.5 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 488 and Alexa Fluor 647 (1:1000 dilution each) in blocking solution. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 5 days)  
2.6 Wash with PBS-T 5 times over 2 days. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time per wash: 6–8 hours)  
2.7 Optional nuclear counterstain: incubation with DAPI (1:10,000 dilution in PBS-T) for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Post-labeling Clearing  
3.1 Re-dehydration with methanol series (20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100%) in PBS-T over 5 days (1 day per step). (Temperature: RT, Time per step: 24 hours)

3.6 Incubation with 100% DBE for 2–3 hours until fully transparent. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2–3 hours)  

4 Refractive Index (RI) Matching and Imaging Preparation  
4.1 Transfer sample to a glass-bottom imaging dish or chamber with 100% DBE. (Temperature: RT, Time: immediate use or storage)  
4.2 Seal sample chamber with vacuum grease or silicone sealant to prevent evaporation.  
4.3 Store at 4 °C in the dark if imaging is delayed. (Time: up to several weeks)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [DAPI, SYCP3, γH2AX, Phalloidin, Cntn2]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is ideal for whole-organ optical clearing of fixed tissues like mouse testes due to its excellent preservation of endogenous fluorescence and compatibility with immunolabeling. It enables rapid delipidation and refractive index homogenization, which is essential for high-resolution 3D imaging of complex tubular networks such as seminiferous tubules. DAPI is used to label nuclei and provide spatial reference for cell layers. SYCP3 labels synaptonemal complexes to identify meiotic prophase I stages. γH2AX marks DNA double-strand breaks, specifically identifying leptotene/zygotene stages of meiotic prophase. Phalloidin labels F-actin to highlight Sertoli cell boundaries and tubule architecture. Cntn2 (Contactin-2) is used to label elongating spermatids, aiding in identifying spermiation zones. This combination allows precise mapping of spermatogenic waves and cellular stratification in 3D.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Immunolabeling (if not already performed)  
1.1 Incubate fixed mouse testis in blocking/permeabilization solution (0.3% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, 5% donkey serum in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
1.2 Incubate with primary antibodies: SYCP3 (1:200), γH2AX (1:300), Cntn2 (1:200) in 0.3% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO in PBS for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.3 Wash 5× 2 hours each with 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 2 hours per wash)  
1.4 Incubate with secondary antibodies (e.g., Alexa Fluor 488, 594, 647 conjugated) and Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 647 (1:200) for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.5 Wash 5× 2 hours each with 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 2 hours per wash)  
1.6 Incubate with DAPI (1:10,000) in PBS for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubate in 20% methanol in PBS for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
2.2 Incubate in 40% methanol in PBS for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
2.3 Incubate in 60% methanol in PBS for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
2.4 Incubate in 80% methanol in PBS for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
2.5 Incubate in 100% methanol for 2 hours (×2 changes). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours per change)  

3 Delipidation  
3.1 Incubate in freshly prepared 5% H₂O₂ in methanol (1:5 dilution of 30% H₂O₂ in methanol) at 4 °C for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
3.2 Wash in 100% methanol (×2) for 2 hours each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours per wash)  

4 Rehydration  
4.1 Incubate in 80% methanol in PBS for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
4.2 Incubate in 60% methanol in PBS for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
4.3 Incubate in 40% methanol in PBS for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
4.4 Incubate in 20% methanol in PBS for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
4.5 Incubate in PBS for 2 hours (×2). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours per wash)  

5 Refractive Index (RI) Matching and Clearing  
5.1 Incubate in iDISCO+ clearing solution (Dibenzyl ether, DBE) at RT for 3 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
5.2 Replace with fresh DBE and incubate at 4 °C for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
5.3 Replace with fresh DBE and incubate at RT until fully transparent (typically 24–48 hours). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24–48 hours)  

6 Mounting and Imaging  
6.1 Mount sample in DBE in a glass-bottom dish or imaging chamber.  
6.2 Image using light-sheet or high-magnification confocal microscopy with multi-channel acquisition for DAPI, Alexa Fluor 488, 594, and 647.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Immunolabeling (if not already performed)  
1.1 Incubation with blocking solution (10% normal goat serum, 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)

1.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-rabbit and Alexa Fluor 594-conjugated anti-mouse (1:1000) in antibody dilution buffer for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.5 Wash with PBS containing 0.1% Triton X-100 (3 × 24 hours). (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 3 × 24 hours)

2.1 Incubation with ScaleS-1 solution (4 M urea, 10% glycerol, 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS, pH 7.0) for 48 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)  
2.2 Incubation with ScaleS-2 solution (4 M urea, 20% sucrose, 10% glycerol, 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS, pH 7.0) for 48 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)

**Justification:** iDISCO+ is ideal for whole-organ optical clearing of large, fixed tissues like the mouse colon. The methanol-based delipidation is compatible with most antibody labeling and allows deep penetration of labeling reagents. HuC/D specifically labels enteric neurons, β-III Tubulin highlights pan-neuronal fibers, and DAPI provides nuclear counterstain for spatial orientation and ganglia segmentation. This combination enables 3D mapping of myenteric and submucosal plexuses at the whole-organ level.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Immunolabeling (if not already performed)  
1.1 Incubation with blocking solution (10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 5% (wt/vol) BSA, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-HuC/D (1:500), anti-β-III Tubulin (1:1000) in labeling buffer (1% DMSO, 3% BSA, 0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS) for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.3 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100 (PBST) for 6 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total)  
1.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-mouse IgG and Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:1000 each) in labeling buffer for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.5 Wash with PBST for 6 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total)  
1.6 Incubation with DAPI (1:10,000 in PBS) for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

3 Delipidation  
3.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 20 volumes methanol) for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
3.2 Incubation with fresh 100% methanol for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
3.3 Incubation with dichloromethane (DCM) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.2 Incubation with 2:1 methanol:DCM for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [HuC/D+Alexa Fluor 488, β-III Tubulin+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI, Phalloidin 633]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is ideal for whole-organ clearing of fixed tissues, offering excellent preservation of fluorescent signals, rapid clearing, and compatibility with multiple immunolabeling strategies. It is particularly suitable for nervous system imaging due to high lipid solubility and tissue homogenization. The labeling strategy uses HuC/D for pan-neuronal soma identification, β-III Tubulin for pan-neurite labeling, DAPI for nuclear counterstain to define ganglion architecture, and Phalloidin 633 to visualize smooth muscle layers and tissue architecture, aiding in regional orientation and segmentation.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Immunolabeling  
1.1 Incubation with blocking/permeabilization solution (10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 5% (vol/vol) donkey serum, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-HuC/D (1:500), anti-β-III Tubulin (1:1000) in labeling solution for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.3 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 (PBT), 6 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total)  
1.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-mouse, Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-rabbit (1:1000) + DAPI (1:1000) + Phalloidin 633 (1:200) in labeling solution for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.5 Wash with PBT, 6 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total)  

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% methanol, 2 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours total)  

3 Delipidation  
3.1 Incubation with freshly prepared dichloromethane (DCM)/methanol (2:1 vol/vol) for 3 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
3.2 Incubation with DCM/methanol (1:2 vol/vol) for 3 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
3.3 Incubation with 100% DCM for 3 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
3.4 Repeat steps 3.1–3.3 every 24 hours until tissue becomes translucent (typically 2–3 cycles).  

4 Rehydration  
4.1 Incubation with DCM/methanol (1:2 vol/vol) for 3 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with DCM/methanol (2:1 vol/vol) for 3 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
4.3 Incubation with 100% methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.5 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.6 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.7 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.8 Incubation with PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

5 Refractive Index (RI) Matching  
5.1 Incubation with iDISCO+ RI matching solution (DBE/Toluene, 1:1 vol/vol) for 3 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
5.2 Incubation with 100% DBE for 12 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
5.3 Incubation with fresh 100% DBE for 12–24 hours until full transparency. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

6 Mounting and Imaging  
6.1 Transfer tissue into a glass-bottom imaging dish or custom chamber with DBE.  
6.2 Image using light-sheet fluorescence microscopy or cleared-tissue optimized confocal microscope.  
6.3 For long-term storage, keep sample in 100% DBE at RT in the dark.

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [HuC/D+Alexa Fluor 488, Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is ideal for large, intact tubular organs like the colon due to its excellent optical clearing, good preservation of fluorescent proteins and immunolabeling, and compatibility with lipophilic dyes. It allows deep penetration and 3D imaging with light-sheet or confocal microscopy. HuC/D labels enteric neurons specifically, Phalloidin highlights F-actin in smooth muscle layers, and DAPI provides nuclear contrast for spatial orientation. This combination enables precise mapping of myenteric and submucosal plexuses relative to muscle layers.

---

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Immunolabeling and Staining  
1.1 Incubation with blocking/permeabilization solution (10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 5% (vol/vol) donkey serum, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with primary antibody HuC/D (1:500 dilution in blocking solution) for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.3 Wash with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS (6 × 1 hour). (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 × 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with secondary antibody Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-mouse IgG (1:1000 in blocking solution) for 48 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 48 hours)  
1.5 Wash with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS (6 × 1 hour). (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 × 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 647 (1:200 dilution in PBS) for 24 hours to label F-actin/smooth muscle. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
1.7 Wash with PBS (3 × 1 hour). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 1 hour)  
1.8 Incubation with DAPI (1:10,000 dilution in PBS) for 2 hours to label nuclei. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
1.9 Wash with PBS (3 × 1 hour). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 1 hour)

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% methanol for 1 hour (2 changes). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)

3 Delipidation  
3.1 Incubation with freshly prepared 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1:20 dilution of 30% H₂O₂ in methanol) for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
3.2 Incubation with fresh 100% methanol for 1 hour (2 changes). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)

4 Rehydration  
4.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.5 Incubation with PBS for 1 hour (2 changes). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)

5 Tissue Clearing  
5.1 Incubation with iDISCO+ clearing solution (20% (vol/vol) DMSO, 20% (vol/vol) NMP in PBS, pH 7.4) for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
5.2 Incubation with iDISCO+ clearing solution (40% (vol/vol) DMSO, 40% (vol/vol) NMP in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
5.3 Incubation with iDISCO+ clearing solution (60% (vol/vol) DMSO, 60% (vol/vol) NMP in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
5.4 Incubation with iDISCO+ final clearing solution (80% (vol/vol) DMSO, 80% (vol/vol) NMP in PBS) until tissue becomes transparent (typically 48–72 hours). (Temperature: RT, Time: 48–72 hours)

6 Refractive Index (RI) Matching  
6.1 Incubation with RI matching solution (DBE:benzyl alcohol = 2:1 vol/vol) for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Replace with fresh RI matching solution and incubate until full transparency is achieved (up to 48 hours). (Temperature: RT, Time: up to 48 hours)

7 Mounting and Imaging  
7.1 Mount the cleared colon in a custom imaging chamber filled with RI matching solution to prevent drying and minimize light scattering.  
7.2 Image using light-sheet fluorescence microscopy or high-penetration confocal microscopy.  
7.3 Acquire z-stacks with appropriate excitation/emission filters for Alexa Fluor 488 (HuC/D), Alexa Fluor 647 (Phalloidin), and DAPI.  
7.4 Perform 3D reconstruction and spatial mapping of myenteric and submucosal plexuses relative to muscle layers and mucosa.

The labeling strategy uses HuC/D for pan-neuronal labeling of cell bodies and β-III Tubulin for pan-axonal labeling of nerve fibers, enabling dual-channel visualization of ganglia and nerve connectivity. This approach avoids endogenous fluorescent proteins, which may be suboptimal in fixed tissues, and instead uses highly specific and bright secondary antibodies.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Tissue Washing and Permeabilization  
1.1 Incubation with PBS containing 0.3% Triton X-100 (PBSTx) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Repeat incubation with fresh PBSTx (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2 Blocking

3 Primary Antibody Labeling  
3.1 Incubation with HuC/D (1:500) and β-III Tubulin (1:1000) in blocking solution (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
3.2 Wash with PBSTx (5×, each Time: 2 hours at RT)

4 Secondary Antibody Labeling  
4.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-mouse and Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-rabbit secondary antibodies (1:1000 each) in blocking solution (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
4.2 Wash with PBSTx (5×, each Time: 2 hours at RT)

5.4 Incubation with 80% methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

请根据该科学问题自行选择合适的荧光/标记策略，并基于所选标记样本选择匹配的组织透明方法。若限制范围内的 Lectin 或 IB4 可以直接标记视网膜血管腔面，应优先作为血管辅助通道；视网膜神经节细胞身份仍需由表内对应靶点完成。请仅输出 protocol，第 1 行写明所选荧光/标记策略和组织透明方法，随后仅列出透明处理、RI 匹配和保存/成像前处理步骤的关键试剂、条件和时间。

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [IB4-Alexa Fluor 647, NeuN-Alexa Fluor 488, DAPI]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is ideal for whole-organ optical clearing of small, fixed tissues like the mouse eye due to its rapid clearing speed, good preservation of fluorescence, and compatibility with immunolabeling. It is particularly effective for deep imaging in intact organs. IB4 is a well-established marker for endothelial cells and directly labels the luminal surface of retinal blood vessels. NeuN is a specific and widely used marker for retinal ganglion cells. DAPI is used for nuclear counterstain to aid in layer segmentation and orientation. This labeling combination enables simultaneous visualization of retinal ganglion cells, vascular architecture, and nuclear organization, while iDISCO+ allows for high-resolution, whole-eye imaging with minimal tissue distortion.

---

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Immunolabeling  
1.1 Incubation with blocking solution (10% (vol/vol) donkey serum, 0.3% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: NeuN (1:500), IB4 (1:200), and DAPI (1:10,000) in labeling buffer (3% (vol/vol) donkey serum, 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS) for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.3 Wash with PBS containing 0.1% (vol/vol) Tween-20 (PBT) for 6 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total)  
1.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 488 anti-mouse (1:1000), Alexa Fluor 647 streptavidin (for IB4), and DAPI in labeling buffer for 72 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.5 Wash with PBT for 6 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total)  

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

3 Delipidation  
3.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 20 volumes methanol) for 12 hours to remove melanin and reduce autofluorescence. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  
3.2 Incubation with fresh 100% methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with dichloromethane (DCM) for 1 hour to delipidate the tissue. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 1:1 DCM:methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Rehydration  
4.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.5 Incubation with PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

5 Refractive Index (RI) Matching  
5.1 Incubation with iDISCO+ RI-matching solution (DBE:BBB = 2:1 vol/vol) for 3 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
5.2 Incubation with fresh iDISCO+ RI-matching solution (DBE:BBB = 1:1 vol/vol) for 3 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
5.3 Incubation with 100% dibenzyl ether (DBE) for 12 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  

6 Mounting and Imaging  
6.1 Mount the cleared whole eye in a glass-bottom dish or imaging chamber filled with DBE.  
6.2 Image using light-sheet or high-magnification confocal microscopy with appropriate filters for Alexa Fluor 488, Alexa Fluor 647, and DAPI.  
6.3 Store samples in 100% DBE at 4 °C in the dark for long-term preservation. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: indefinite)

IB4-Alexa Fluor 647 directly labels the luminal surface of retinal vessels without the need for antibodies, while NeuN+Alexa Fluor 488 specifically labels retinal ganglion cells. 1.3 Wash with PBS containing 0.3% Triton X-100 (6 × 1 hour at RT)  
1.4 Optional: Incubation with secondary antibody (e.g., Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-mouse IgG, 1:1000) if primary is unconjugated (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 48 hours)  
1.5 Wash with PBS containing 0.3% Triton X-100 (6 × 1 hour at RT)  

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% methanol in PBS (vol/vol) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% methanol in PBS (vol/vol) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% methanol in PBS (vol/vol) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% methanol in PBS (vol/vol) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% methanol (3 × 1 hour) (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours total)  

3 Delipidation  
3.1 Incubation with freshly prepared 5% H2O2 in methanol (1:20 dilution of 30% H2O2 in methanol) (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)

4.2 Incubation with 60% methanol in PBS (vol/vol) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC  
**Chosen Labeling:** [CD31+Alexa Fluor 647, NeuN+Alexa Fluor 488, DAPI]  
**Justification:** CUBIC is selected over EyeCi due to its superior ability to handle pigmented tissues like the RPE, with extended incubation in CUBIC-L and CUBIC-RA allowing for more complete delipidation, pigment bleaching, and RI matching. CUBIC also preserves fluorescence well, especially from Alexa Fluor dyes. CD31 labels endothelial cells for vascular structure, NeuN labels retinal ganglion cells, and DAPI provides nuclear counterstain for layer identification and spatial orientation. This labeling strategy enables co-registration of ganglion cell distribution and vascular architecture with minimal background and high resolution.

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Immunolabeling Completion (if not already performed)  
1.1 Incubation with blocking solution (10% normal goat serum, 0.3% Triton X-100 in PBS) for 24 hours (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: NeuN (1:500), CD31 (1:200) in blocking solution for 72 hours (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 72 hours)  
1.3 Wash with PBS containing 0.1% Triton X-100, 6 × 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 × 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 488 anti-mouse (NeuN), Alexa Fluor 647 anti-rat (CD31) at 1:500 dilution in blocking solution for 48 hours (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 48 hours)  
1.5 Wash with PBS containing 0.1% Triton X-100, 6 × 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 × 1 hour)  
1.6 Nuclear staining with DAPI (1:10,000 in PBS) for 12 hours (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)  

2 Tissue Optical Clearing (CUBIC-L)  
2.1 Incubation with CUBIC-L reagent (10% TCA, 25% urea, 15% sucrose, 10% glycerol, 10% formamide in 50 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0) for 48 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)  
2.2 Replace with fresh CUBIC-L and incubate for another 48 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)  

3 Washing  
3.1 Wash with PBS containing 0.1% Triton X-100, 6 × 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 × 1 hour)  
3.2 Wash with PBS containing 0.05% Tween-20, 3 × 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 1 hour)  

4 Delipidation and Pigment Removal (CUBIC-RA)  
4.1 Incubation with CUBIC-RA reagent (10% TCA, 25% urea, 15% sucrose, 10% glycerol, 10% formamide, 1% SDS in 50 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0) for 72 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 72 hours)  
4.2 Replace with fresh CUBIC-RA and incubate for another 48 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)  

5 Washing  
5.1 Wash with PBS containing 0.1% Triton X-100, 6 × 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 × 1 hour)  
5.2 Wash with PBS containing 0.05% Tween-20, 3 × 1 hour (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 1 hour)  

6 Refractive Index Matching  
6.1 Incubation with CUBIC-R2 (50% sucrose, 25% urea, 10% glycerol, 10% formamide in PBS) for 24 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Replace with fresh CUBIC-R2 and incubate for another 24 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

7 Final Clearing and Mounting  
7.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) glycerol in PBS for 12 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
7.2 Incubation with 100% glycerol for 24 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
7.3 Mount in 100% glycerol or CUBIC-R2 for imaging (Temperature: RT, Time: immediate use or store at 4 °C for up to 2 weeks)
